tagShapeMismatches.english: Spells and nonmagical equipment mentioned in the adventure are described in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. Magic items are described in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, unless the adventure's text directs you to an item's description in {@adventure appendix C|BGDIA|12}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 冒險中寫到的法術和非魔法裝備都在{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}裡包含。除了冒險文字表明某魔法物品在{@adventure 附錄C|BGDIA|12}中詳述的魔法物品外，其他魔法物品都在{@book 城主指南|DMG}詳述。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Whaul Nightley (neutral half-orc {@creature thug} with {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet), a jovial, strong-jawed rat-catcher with a bellowing laugh
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 沃爾·奈特莉，具有 60 尺的{@sense 黑暗視覺}的絕對中立半獸人{@creature 暴徒}，一個快活的大下巴的捕鼠人，有著風箱一樣的笑聲。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The {@i Uncivil Serpent} has the statistics of a {@vehicle sailing ship} (see {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||chapter 5} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). If you need a deck plan, use the ship map in {@book appendix C|DMG|12} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. Although the ship is worth 10,000 gp intact, no one in Baldur's Gate wants to buy it because of its infamous reputation.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@i 狂野大蛇號}使用{@vehicle 帆船}的資料面板（請參閱《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》中{@table 擁有一艘船; 空中與水上載具||第五章}）。如果你需要船隻的甲板平面圖，請使用《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》{@book 附錄C|DMG|12}的船隻地圖。儘管船值 10000 GP，但是由於這船的名聲是如此地臭名昭著以至博德之門沒人會想買這艘船。

tagShapeMismatches.english: From dawn to midnight, characters can expect to find {@dice 1d6} human {@creature Commoner||commoners} bathing here at any given time. From midnight to dawn, three female human {@creature Night Blade|BGDIA|night blades} stand guard near the pools and attack trespassers on sight. If a fight breaks out here, the {@creature necromite of Myrkul|BGDIA} in {@adventure area D4|BGDIA|1|D4. North Massage Room} joins the fray in the second round of combat.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 從黎明到午夜之間的任何給定時間，冒險者們可以在裡面找到 {@dice 1d6} 名人類{@creature 平民||平民}在那裡泡澡。而從午夜到黎明之間，三個女性人類{@creature 夜刃|BGDIA|夜刃}會守衛在澡池附近並且攻擊任何他們看到的入侵者。如果這裡發生戰鬥，位於{@adventure 區域D4|BGDIA|1|D4. 北部按摩室}的{@creature 米爾寇之屍從|BGDIA}就會在戰鬥的第二輪加入打鬥。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In addition to her robe and her flail, Flennis carries a dusty spellbook that contains all the spells she has prepared. The book has black leather covers and sports a tiny, skull-shaped locking mechanism. Flennis has the key to the lock stuck in her hair. A character can also pick the lock with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check made with {@item thieves' tools|phb}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 除了她的長袍和連枷之外，福尼斯還帶著一本沾滿塵土的法術書，上面記載了所有她已經準備的魔法。這本書有一個黑色的皮革封面並被一個小的頭骨形狀的機械裝置鎖住了。福尼斯把鑰匙藏在了她的頭髮裡。角色也可以透過使用{@item 盜賊工具|phb}透過一次 {@dc 10} 的敏捷檢定開啟這個鎖。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Bringing a lit torch or other open flame into the gas-filled room triggers an explosion that fills the chamber. Creatures fully immersed in the water take no damage, but all others must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@dice 4d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. All the wooden beams that support the ceiling are destroyed in the explosion, which could cause a roof collapse (see "{@area Dungeon Features|044|x}" in {@adventure area D5|BGDIA|1|D5. Welcome to the Dungeon}). The explosion also burns away the gas, which builds up slowly and becomes dangerous again after 24 hours.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 攜帶任何點燃的火把或者是其他明火進入這個瓦斯聚集的區域都會引發整個房間的爆炸。完全浸入在水中的生物不會受到任何傷害，其他生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則遭受 14（{@dice 4d6}）點火焰傷害，成功則傷害減半。所有支撐著天花板的柱子將在爆炸中被摧毀，並且可能造成房間的塌方（請參閱{@adventure 區域D5|BGDIA|1|D5. 歡迎來到地下城}的"{@area 地下城特徵物|044|x}"）。爆炸同樣會燃盡瓦斯氣體，而瓦斯會緩慢地重新湧入房間並且在 24 小時後重新充滿整個房間。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If it's present when the cultists of Tiamat confront the characters, the {@condition invisible} {@creature imp} in {@adventure area D1|BGDIA|1|D1. Courtyard} quietly observes the interaction before reporting back to {@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA} at his family's villa.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們和提亞馬特的邪教徒們遭遇了的話，位於{@adventure 區域D1|BGDIA|1|D1. 庭院}的{@condition 隱形}{@creature 小魔鬼}會在安靜地觀察完一切後回去向位於範薩姆普爾別墅的{@creature 瑟斯維爾·範薩姆普爾|BGDIA}彙報。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Laraelra hides the key to the chest in the adjacent bedpost, whose top unscrews to reveal the hidden compartment where the key is sequestered. The chest's padlock can otherwise be picked with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check made with {@item thieves' tools|phb}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 拉瑞娜將掛鎖的鑰匙藏在了旁邊的床柱裡，擰開床柱的螺絲會發現一個暗格，鑰匙就藏在那裡面。角色們也可以使用{@item 盜賊工具|phb}並透過一個{@dc 20}的敏捷檢定來開啟箱子上的掛鎖。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As an NPC, Reya falls under the DM's control. But if running her becomes too much of a burden for you, see if one of the players wants to run Reya as a secondary character. You can provide the consenting player with a copy of the {@creature veteran} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 作為一個NPC，蕾婭歸於DM操控。但如果操作她對你而已是一個過重的負擔的話，你可以詢問是否有玩家願意將蕾婭作為第二角色來扮演，你可以向願意的玩家展示{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中{@creature 老兵}的資料。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Five lawful evil human {@creature Guard||guards} stand watch here—one by each door. They attack anyone not accompanied by a Vanthampur family member. If they hear trouble elsewhere, the guards can't be {@status surprised}, but they stay put unless ordered to move by a member of the family. Combat here alerts {@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA} in {@area area V13|0af|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 5 名守序邪惡人類{@creature 警衛||警衛}看守著這裡，他們分別站在每扇門邊。他們會攻擊任何在沒有範薩姆普爾家族成員陪伴而進入該區域的人。如果他們聽到別的地方發生了麻煩，那麼警衛就不會被{@status 突襲}，但他們也不會在沒有其他範薩姆普爾家族成員命令下離開這裡。這裡發生的戰鬥會讓{@area 區域V13|0af|x}的{@creature 瑟斯維爾·範薩姆普爾|BGDIA}警惕。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If any wandering cultists are defeated, reduce the number of cultists encountered in {@area area V33|0db|x} accordingly. If the characters make no effort to hide the bodies of the cultists they defeat, someone stumbles upon them eventually and warns the {@creature barbed devil} in {@area area V26|0ca|x}. Assuming it hasn't been defeated already, the devil scours the dungeon for trespassers once notified of their presence.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們擊敗了任意數量的邪教徒，將{@area 區域V33|0db|x}遭遇的教徒的數量進行相應的減少。如果角色們沒有嘗試去隱藏那些邪教徒的屍體，將會有人無意發現這些屍體同時將此事報告給{@area 區域V26|0ca|x}的{@creature 蝟魔}，前提是他還沒有被擊敗。一旦這個魔鬼被告知出現入侵者，他就會開始搜尋入侵者。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When the characters first show up, one patron stands out among the rest: a chaotic good {@creature ogre} wearing a {@item headband of intellect}. He sits by himself in a corner, reading a book titled {@i The Sum of Theology} by Saint Vetheera, a servant of Oghma (god of knowledge).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當角色們第一次在酒館露面時，有一名客人如此與眾不同：一個帶著{@item 智力頭帶}的混亂善良{@creature 食人魔}。他正獨自坐在角落裡，閱讀一本名叫{@i 神學概論}的書，由聖維瑟拉所著，他是知識之神歐格瑪的僕從。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} was polymorphed into an otter years ago, and decided he preferred the new form to his original one (that of a wizened old man). His otter form was made permanent by a {@spell wish} spell. He uses the {@creature archmage} stat block, but is a Tiny beast with a Strength of 3. His alignment is chaotic good, and he speaks Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, Gnomish, Halfling, and Troglodyte. He has the {@spell plane shift} spell prepared instead of {@spell teleport}, and is searching for the tuning fork he needs to cast the spell. What little he knows about the characters has been communicated to him by {@spell sending} spells, sent by {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA} in advance of their arrival.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 特拉克西哥|BGDIA}在許多年前變成了一隻水獺，並且決定就一直保持這樣了（在那之前他是一個乾瘦的老人）。他用{@spell 祈願術}永久變成了水獺形態。他使用的是{@creature 大法師}的資料，但他是一個小型野獸，並且只有力量 3。他的陣營是混亂善良，他會說通用語，龍語，矮人語，侏儒語，半身人語和戰蜥人語。他準備了{@spell 位面轉移}而不是{@spell 傳送術}，而且他正在尋找施展法術所需要的音叉。他對於角色們的瞭解僅限於在之前{@creature 西爾維拉·薩維卡斯|BGDIA}使用{@spell 短訊術}告訴他的。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Characters can help {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} search for his missing tuning fork, which is keyed to the Nine Hells. Whoever rolls the highest on a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds the tuning fork. Whoever rolls the lowest finds a random trinket, determined by rolling on the {@item Trinket|PHB|Trinkets table} in chapter 5 of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} doesn't care if the character keeps the trinket or not, and doesn't remember how or when he acquired it.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以幫助{@creature 特拉克西哥|BGDIA}去尋找他不見的音叉，那是他們前往九獄的關鍵。他們所有人進行一次感知（{@skill 察覺}）檢定，數值最高的角色將發現音叉。數值最低的角色會發現一個隨機的飾品，這個飾品具體是什麼，將在{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}第五章中的{@item 飾品|PHB|飾品表}中投骰決定。{@creature 特拉克西哥|BGDIA}不會在乎角色們是否拿走這個飾品，因為他都不記得他是怎麼得到它的了。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature narzugon|MTF} patrols the streets of Elturel on the back of a {@creature nightmare} equipped with {@item infernal tack|MTF}. The devil has orders to hunt down and destroy any demons that might have slipped past the battle on the ground below and gained access to the city.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一名騎在裝備有{@item 煉獄鞍具|MTF}的{@creature 夢魘}背上的{@creature 魘騎魔|MTF}在埃爾託瑞爾的街道巡邏。魔鬼下令追捕並消滅所有可能越過下方地面戰場並進入城市的惡魔。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The doors of the cathedral are made of iron. Each door is a Large object with AC 19, 27 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. If a door in the cathedral is locked, it can be unlocked with a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check with {@item thieves' tools|phb}, or forced open with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 大教堂的門都是鐵製的。每扇門都是一個大型物體，具有AC 19、27 生命值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。如果大教堂中的一扇門被鎖定，則可以使用{@item 盜賊工具|phb}透過成功的{@dc 17} 敏捷檢定將其解鎖，或者透過成功的{@dc 20} 力量（{@skill 運動}）檢定將其強制開啟。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Most of the cathedral's windows were shattered during the descent into Avernus, but the windows are covered by defensive shutters that are latched from within and swing outward on iron hinges. A successful {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check or {@dc 15} Dexterity check with {@item thieves' tools|phb} opens a shutter from the outside. Each shutter is a Large object with AC 19, 27 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 大教堂的大部分窗戶在下降到阿弗納斯的過程中都破碎了，但窗戶被防禦性護窗覆蓋，這些窗板從內部上鎖和並透過鐵鉸鏈向外擺動。使用{@item 盜賊工具|phb}成功進行{@dc 15} 敏捷檢定或{@dc 17} 力量（{@skill 運動}）檢定可從外面開啟窗板。每扇護窗都是一個大型物體，具有AC 19、27 生命值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害具有免疫。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Seltern Obranch, a {@creature druid} dedicated to {@deity Silvanus|Faerûnian|SCAG}, was here when the attack took place. After being knocked down in the melee, he feigned his demise to trick his attackers. If the characters search the bodies, they notice Seltern open his eyes.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 襲擊發生時，信仰於{@deity 西凡那斯|費倫|SCAG}的{@creature 德魯伊}賽爾特恩·歐布蘭馳就在這裡。在混戰中被擊倒後，他裝死騙過了攻擊者。如果角色搜刮屍體，他們會注意到賽爾特恩睜開了他的眼睛。

tagShapeMismatches.english: This large temple was used for private ceremonies involving the most powerful and respected figures in Elturel. Each of the semicircular alcoves here contains an elaborate, upright sarcophagus holding the body of a former high priest of Torm. A sarcophagus can be opened with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check by a character proficient with {@item thieves' tools|phb}. Eleven of the sarcophagi contain partially decomposed bodies. The twelfth sarcophagus holds a {@creature mummy}, which attacks as soon as its coffin is opened.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這座大神殿曾被用作涉及埃爾託瑞爾最有影響力和最受尊敬的人物的私人儀式。這裡的每個半圓形凹室都包含一個精緻的，豎立的石棺，每口棺材中安放著一位前託姆大祭司的屍體。熟練使用{@item 盜賊工具|phb}的角色可以透過成功的{@dc 20} 敏捷檢定來開啟一個石棺。十一具石棺中包含有部分腐爛的屍體。第十二具石棺中有隻{@creature 木乃伊}，會在棺材被開啟那一刻發動攻擊。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If captured, the self-serving quasit can be coerced into providing information about the portal and the plans of its demonic masters (see "{@area Demon Portal|162|x}") with a successful {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果被捕獲，則可以透過成功進行{@dc 10} 魅力（{@skill 威嚇}）檢定，以強迫這隻自私的小惡魔提供有關傳送門及其惡魔主人計劃的資訊（請參閱" {@area 惡魔傳送門|162|x} "）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Guided by {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} the hollyphant and discoveries made in Elturel, the characters trek across Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells, to recover the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} and free Elturel from its chains. Navigating the wastelands of Avernus might seem like a difficult proposition, but thankfully the characters have the map given to them by {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA} in {@adventure chapter 1|BGDIA|1}. For more information on how to use the Avernus poster map, see "{@area Using the Poster Map|1b0|x}".
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 冒險者們在聖飛象{@creature 露露|BGDIA}和在埃爾託瑞爾獲得的新發現的引導下，穿越九層地獄的第一層阿弗納斯，去尋回{@item 扎瑞爾之劍|BGDIA}，並將埃爾託瑞爾從鐵索中解放出來。雖然在阿弗納斯的廢土中找到方向是極其困難的，但所幸的是在{@adventure 第一章|BGDIA|1}中{@creature 西爾維拉·薩維卡斯|BGDIA}給了冒險者們地圖。想要了解更多阿弗納斯海報地圖的資訊可參閱"{@area 使用海報地圖|1b0|x}"。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If a character attempts to map Avernus, madness begins to set in. After each mapping session, the character must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the character contracts a random form of madness determined by rolling on the {@table short-term madness||Short-Term Madness table} in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. If the character fails this saving throw a second time, roll on the {@table Long-Term Madness} table instead. If the character fails a third time, roll on the {@table Indefinite Madness} table.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果一名角色試圖繪製阿弗納斯，瘋狂就會開始出現。每個繪圖過程後，角色必須進行一次{@dc 15}的感知豁免。如果該角色豁免失敗，在《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》第 8 章的"{@table 短暫性瘋狂||短暫性瘋狂}"上進行投擲，從而獲得一種隨機的瘋狂狀態。如果角色第二次豁免失敗，投擲{@table 長期性瘋狂}。如果角色第三次失敗，投擲{@table 永久性瘋狂}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Redcaps are murderous fey creatures that soak their caps in fresh blood. Madcaps are redcaps that drench their caps in demon ichor instead. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} currently commands sixty redcaps and thirty madcaps, although a third of them operate outside the fort, patrolling the areas of the wasteland controlled by {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}. As battles deplete this force, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} has new redcaps delivered to her from the Feywild, courtesy of powerful fey with whom she has struck bargains. For this reason, the night hag has no concern for the well-being of her redcap and madcap minions. See {@adventure appendix D|BGDIA|13} for more information about {@creature Redcap|VGM|redcaps} and {@creature Redcap|VGM|madcaps}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 紅帽子是嗜殺的精類生物，他們將其帽子浸潤在新鮮血液中。瘋帽子是將自己帽子浸潤在惡魔膿液中而不是血液的紅帽子。{@creature 瘋喜鵲|BGDIA}目前指揮著 60 個紅帽子和 30 個瘋帽子，儘管其中有三分之一在堡壘外{@creature 瘋喜鵲|BGDIA}控制著的荒原地區巡邏。隨著戰鬥消耗了這支部隊，{@creature 瘋喜鵲|BGDIA}從妖精荒野那裡獲得了新的一些紅帽子，這是與她進行交易的強大妖精所提供的。由於這個原因，夜鬼婆並不關心她的紅帽子和瘋帽子奴隸們過得好不好。有關{@creature 紅帽子|VGM|瘋帽子}和{@creature 紅帽子|VGM|紅帽子}的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|BGDIA|13}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters earn enough gratitude from {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}, one or both of these war machines might be gifted to them. {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} can attach wheels to the {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA} and a weapon to the {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA}, if {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} instructs them to. Replacing the armor on the Tormentor can be done as well, but only after efforts are made to salvage scrap metal from the battlefields of Avernus. Any such salvage operation is likely to attract unwanted attention from other warlords (see "{@area Warlords of the Avernian Wastelands|1e0|x}").
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們從{@creature 瘋喜鵲|BGDIA}那裡贏得足夠的感激，那麼這些地獄戰爭機器中的一臺或兩臺都可能會是送給角色們的禮物。如果得到了{@creature 瘋喜鵲|BGDIA}的指示，{@creature 楚卡|BGDIA}和{@creature 克朗克|BGDIA}可以將輪子安裝到{@vehicle 魔鬼座駕|BGDIA}上，並將武器加裝到{@vehicle 摧殘者|BGDIA}上。當然也可以更換摧殘者的裝甲，但是這只有在努力蒐集阿弗納斯戰場上的廢金屬之後才能完成。任何此類蒐集行動都可能引起其他軍閥的不必要注意（請參見{@area 阿弗納斯廢土上的軍閥們|1e0|x}）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In addition to the war machines described above, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} has several infernal war machines in drivable condition that are undergoing regular maintenance and upgrades in her garage under the hill. These vehicles are not for sale or trade, though brazen adventurers might try stealing them. These vehicles include two {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|Devil's Rides}, three {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|Tormentors}, the aforementioned {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA} (which {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} have been trying to repair), and a {@vehicle Scavenger|BGDIA} that {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} uses for salvage operations.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 除了上述的地獄戰爭機器外，{@creature 瘋喜鵲|BGDIA}還擁有幾臺處於可驅動狀態的地獄戰爭機器，它們正在山下的車庫中進行定期維護和升級。這些戰車不會用於出售或交易，儘管大膽的冒險者可能會嘗試偷走它們。這些戰車包括兩臺{@vehicle 魔鬼座駕|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}，三臺{@vehicle 摧殘者|BGDIA|摧殘者}，一臺上文提到的{@vehicle 惡魔粉碎者|BGDIA}（{@creature 楚卡|BGDIA}和{@creature 克朗克|BGDIA}一直在試圖修理的那臺）和一臺{@creature 瘋喜鵲|BGDIA}用於進行回收的{@vehicle 拾荒者|BGDIA}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA} drives a {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA} that has an Infernal Screamer (see "{@vehupgrade Infernal Screamer|BGDIA}") instead of a Harpoon Flinger. {@creature Hobgoblin||Hobgoblins} round out the Tormentor's crew. High Graj Karkajuk drives a {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA} and commands a pair of {@vehicle Scavenger|BGDIA|Scavengers} driven by {@creature Hobgoblin Captain||hobgoblin captains} and crewed by ordinary {@creature Hobgoblin||hobgoblins}. See {@adventure appendix B|BGDIA|11} for the vehicles' stat blocks.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 苦痛之息|BGDIA}駕駛著一臺裝有地獄尖嚎裝置（請參見"{@vehupgrade 地獄尖嚎裝置|BGDIA}"）來替代一個魚叉投射機的{@vehicle 摧殘者|BGDIA}。車組人員全是{@creature 大地精||大地精}。大格拉傑·卡卡朱克駕駛著一臺{@vehicle 魔鬼座駕|BGDIA}並且指揮著兩臺{@vehicle 拾荒者|BGDIA|清道夫}，清道夫均由{@creature 大地精長官||大地精長官}駕駛並由{@creature 大地精||大地精}充任車組成員。有關戰車的資料面板，請參閱{@adventure 附錄 B|BGDIA|11}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Feonor|BGDIA} rides around in a {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA} called {@i Golden Doom}, so named because Mahadi fitted it with gilded death armor (see "{@vehupgrade Gilded Death Armor|BGDIA}"). The vehicle is driven by a {@creature ghast}, and its other stations are operated by {@creature Ghoul||ghouls}. She also commands a force of ten {@creature Crawling Claw||crawling claws}. A pair of {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|Tormentors} crewed by {@creature Mezzoloth||mezzoloths} provide escort.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 菲奧諾|BGDIA}坐在一臺名為{@i 黃金厄運}的{@vehicle 惡魔粉碎者|BGDIA}上，之所以這樣命名是因為馬哈迪給這臺戰車安裝了鍍金死亡裝甲（請參閱"{@vehupgrade 鍍金死亡裝甲|BGDIA}"）。這臺戰車由一隻{@creature 妖鬼}駕駛，其餘部分由{@creature 食屍鬼||食屍鬼們}操作。她同時也指揮著一支由 10 只{@creature 蠕行之爪||蠕行之爪們}組成的戰力。兩臺由{@creature 毒蟲羅斯魔||毒蟲羅斯魔}作為車組的{@vehicle 摧殘者|BGDIA|摧殘者}為她提供護衛。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Kovik has a {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA} and travels with two {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} on similar vehicles. The rest of the gang consists of four {@creature Barbed Devil||barbed devils} on a {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA} and eight {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} on a {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA}. Members of the Eighth Remnant never use demon ichor in their vehicles.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 科維克有著一臺{@vehicle 魔鬼座駕|BGDIA}，兩隻{@creature 須魔||須魔}騎在類似的戰車上和他一起行進。這個幫派剩下的成員包含了在一臺{@vehicle 摧殘者|BGDIA}上的 4 只{@creature 蝟魔||蝟魔}和在一臺{@vehicle 惡魔粉碎者|BGDIA}上的 8 只{@creature 須魔||須魔}。第八殘餘的成員從來都不在他們的戰車上使用惡魔穢液。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In battle, Arkhan uses {@spell branding smite} to channel the radiant power of Tiamat into his weapon attacks. If a fight turns against him, he uses the {@spell teleport} power of the {@item Hand of Vecna} to return to his tower with as many allies as possible. Should one or more of his comrades fall in battle, Arkhan uses {@spell revivify} and {@spell raise dead} spells to bring them back to life as soon as possible.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在戰鬥中，阿克漢利用{@spell 印記斬}將提亞瑪特的神力引入他的武器攻擊中。如果在戰鬥中處於劣勢，他將利用{@item 維克那魔掌}的{@spell 傳送術}帶著儘可能多的盟友一起返回塔樓。如果他的一個或多個戰友陣亡，阿克漢將使用法術{@spell 回生術}和{@spell 死者復活}以使他們儘快復活返回戰鬥。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters defeat the fire giants, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} commends their victory and offers them the same deal as before. If the characters refuse him a second time, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} smiles and says, "A pity. All those poor people in Elturel were counting on you." He then offers to teleport them out of his fortress, so they can be on their way. Gracious host that {@creature Bel|BGDIA} is, he won't attack the characters directly unless they attack him first, in which case he casts {@spell imprisonment} on a party member ({@creature Lulu|BGDIA} being his first choice). If the spell works, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} vows to release his prisoner once the nine adamantine rods are found and returned to him, no questions asked.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果冒險者們擊敗了火巨人，{@creature 貝爾|BGDIA}會對他們的勝利讚賞有加，並在此提出之前的交易。如果角色們第二次拒絕他，{@creature 貝爾|BGDIA}會露齒一笑，說道"真是遺憾，所有在埃爾託瑞爾的人們還指望著你們呢" 他隨後提出可以把他們傳送出他的堡壘，大路朝天，各走一邊。{@creature 貝爾|BGDIA}是個非常親切有禮的主人，除非角色們率先攻擊他，他不會親自對角色們動手。如果他動手回擊，他會率先向一位成員（{@creature 露露|BGDIA}是他的第一目標）施放{@spell 禁錮術}。 如果法術施展成功，{@creature 貝爾|BGDIA}會起誓，在角色們幫他找回九根精金法杖後會放人，一概不究。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s fiends captured a {@creature sibriex|MTF} and have been torturing and interrogating it for quite a long time now. The sibriex is {@condition restrained} by infernal chains from {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s forge that also prevent it from using its spells or actions to escape.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 貝爾|BGDIA}手下的邪魔們抓住了一個{@creature 巨顱魔|MTF}，並且已經對其折磨和拷問了很長時間。巨顱魔被{@creature 貝爾|BGDIA}的鍛爐製造的的煉獄鎖鏈{@condition 束縛}，不能使用它的咒語和動作來掙脫。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Two {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|Devil's Rides}, one driven by {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and the other by {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} (see "{@area Chukka and Clonk|1c0|x}"). Each kenku carries a small bag containing three {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 楚卡|BGDIA}和{@creature 克朗克|BGDIA}（見{@area 楚卡和克朗克|1c0|x}）分別跨著兩架{@vehicle 魔鬼座駕|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}。這兩位天狗各帶著一個裝著三枚{@item 靈魂幣|BGDIA|靈魂幣}的小包。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA} crewed by Barnabas the {@creature flameskull} (using its {@spell mage hand} spell to drive) and three {@creature Redcap|VGM|redcaps}. Clinging to the vehicle's outer hull are six {@creature Redcap|VGM|madcaps}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個叫巴納巴斯的{@creature 燃焰之顱}駕駛著一輛{@vehicle 摧殘者|BGDIA}（他用{@spell 法師之手}駕車）， 帶著三個{@creature 紅帽子|VGM|紅帽子}。車外還攀附著著六個{@creature 紅帽子|VGM|瘋帽子}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The gnoll is a shapechanged {@creature death slaad} under the effects of a {@spell feeblemind} spell. While fighting alongside Yeenoghu's demon hordes, the slaad fell into the River Styx, leaving it in a feebleminded state. In five days, it gets a new saving throw to end the effect. Any character who examines the gnoll and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check realizes that some sort of magical effect has reduced it to a witless nincompoop.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這隻鬣狗人是一個受到{@spell 弱智術}影響的變形後的{@creature 史拉亡蟾}。 它是在和耶諾古的惡魔獸群一起戰鬥時跌入了冥河，陷入了弱智的狀態。在五天內，他將再次骰出對此效果的豁免檢定。任一角色可以透過一個{@dc 15}的智力（{@skill 奧秘}）檢定，可以發現是某種魔法效果讓它變成了如今的弱智傻蛋。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters killed {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} in {@adventure chapter 1|BGDIA|1}, his soul ends up in the Nine Hells, where it emerges from the River Styx as a lemure. Zariel instantly becomes aware of Thavius's fate and retrieves him. After promoting Thavius to an amnizu devil for his faithful service, Zariel confines him until Elturel's destruction. The characters find Thavius trapped in a cell aboard Zariel's flying fortress, feeling sorry for himself.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們在{@adventure 第一章|BGDIA|1}中殺死了{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}，他的靈魂最終會到達九層地獄，從冥河中以劣魔的形式出現。扎瑞爾立刻意識到Thavius的命運並將他救出。在提升Thavius為安祖魔魔鬼以表彰他的忠誠服務後，扎瑞爾將他關押起來，直到艾爾託瑞爾的毀滅。角色們在扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘上的一個牢房中找到了自怨自艾的Thavius。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Alazub came to the scab to spy on Trantolox's progress for Zariel. If Alazub is freed, a character who makes a successful Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check against Alazub's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check can convince the devil that Zariel sent the characters to save it. If convinced that the characters are on its side, a character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check convinces Alazub to share the following information:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 阿拉祖布來到這片荒地，為扎瑞爾監視特蘭託洛克斯的進展。如果阿拉祖布被釋放，一個角色若能用魅力（{@skill 欺瞞}）檢定成功對抗阿拉祖布的感知（{@skill 洞悉}）檢定，就能說服這位魔鬼相信扎瑞爾派這些角色來救它。如果阿拉祖布被說服認為這些人站在它這一邊，一個角色若能用魅力（{@skill 遊說}）檢定成功透過{@dc 15}的難度等級，就能說服阿拉祖布分享以下資訊：

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals six magic items in the niches, including a black sack made of stitched flesh, a lustrous black gem shaped like a human baby's fist, an {@item iron flask} containing a berserk {@creature fiendish flesh golem|BGDIA} that can't be controlled, and three {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}. The sack is Yiggleblight's {@i soul bag}, which is of no use to the characters. The black gem is the night hag's {@i heartstone}. (For more information on these two magic items, see the "{@creature Night Hag}" entry in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}.)
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個{@spell 偵測魔法}法術揭示了壁龕中的六個魔法物品，包括一個由縫合的肉體製成的黑色袋子，一個像人類嬰兒拳頭一樣形狀的有光澤的黑色寶石，一個裝有無法控制的狂暴{@creature 邪魔血肉魔像|BGDIA}的{@item 收妖瓶}，以及三枚{@item 靈魂幣|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。這個袋子是伊格爾布萊特的{@i 靈魂袋}，對角色們沒有用處。黑色寶石是夜魔的{@i 心石}。（有關這兩件魔法物品的更多資訊，請參閱{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的"{@creature 夜鬼婆}"條目。）

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature giant hyena} attacks a {@creature mastiff} near the statue of Zariel ({@area area I2|2f7|x}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一隻{@creature 巨鬣狗}在扎瑞爾雕像附近（{@area 區域I2|2f7|x}）攻擊一隻{@creature 獒犬}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If a character kills a guard, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s mind attempts to punish the character. That character must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} as {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s mind saps the character's energy.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果某個角色殺死了一名守衛，{@creature 露露|BGDIA}的心靈會試圖懲罰這個角色。該角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 的感知豁免檢定，否則會因 {@creature 露露|BGDIA}的心靈吸取其能量而獲得1層 {@condition 力竭}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: For Zariel to fall beyond redemption is the worst outcome for {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}. This unimaginable tragedy shatters the hollyphant's mind, leaving {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} insane. Roll or choose the specific effects of her madness from the {@table long-term madness||Long-Term Madness table} in {@book chapter 8|DMG|8} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, but this madness can be overcome only by a {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 對於{@creature 露露|BGDIA}來說，扎瑞爾墮落到無可救藥的地步是最糟糕的結果。這一難以想象的悲劇擊碎了這頭神聖象的心靈，使{@creature 露露|BGDIA}陷入瘋狂。從{@book 城主指南|DMG}的{@book 第八章|DMG|8}中的{@table 長期性瘋狂||長期性瘋狂表}中擲骰或選擇她的瘋狂具體效果，但只有透過{@spell 高等復原術}或類似魔法才能克服這種瘋狂。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters agree to Zariel's terms, they learn that both demon lords have recently converged around Elturel. You can add either demon lord to the battle in "{@area Endgame in Elturel|340|x}" later in this chapter. If the characters freed the demon lord {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} in {@area chapter 3|22a|x}, he can also make an appearance.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們同意扎瑞爾的條件，他們將得知兩位惡魔領主最近都聚集在Elturel周圍。你可以在本章後面的"{@area 埃爾託瑞爾的終局|340|x}"戰鬥中加入任一惡魔領主。如果角色們在{@area 第三章|22a|x}中釋放了惡魔領主{@creature 科斯徹奇|BGDIA}，他也可以出現。

tagShapeMismatches.english: After making these ability checks, the characters stumble into a battle between six {@creature Hezrou||hezrous} and Lucille, the {@creature pit fiend} general they spotted as they were leaving Elturel at the end of {@area chapter 2|193|x}:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在進行這些能力檢定後，角色們意外地捲入了六隻{@creature 狂蟾魔||狂蟾魔}與他們在離開{@area 第二章|193|x}結尾的埃圖爾時所見到的{@creature 深獄煉魔}將軍露西爾之間的戰鬥中：

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters released {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} from his prison in {@area chapter 3|22a|x} but lost track of him, the demon lord wades into battle and tries to get close enough to Zariel to wrest {@item Matalotok|BGDIA}, his hammer, from her clutches. Devils loyal to Zariel confound {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} at every turn, denying him his prize, and Zariel herself refuses to engage him. Still, the characters can count on {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} to create a distraction big enough to draw attention away from their activities, whatever those might be.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們在{@area 第三章|22a|x}釋放了{@creature 科斯徹奇|BGDIA}，但隨後失去了他的蹤跡，這位惡魔領主會踏入戰場，試圖靠近扎瑞爾，以便從她手中奪回{@item 瑪塔洛托克|BGDIA}，他的錘子。忠於扎瑞爾的惡魔在每一個轉折點上都使{@creature 科斯徹奇|BGDIA}感到困惑，不讓他得到他的獎品，而扎瑞爾本人則拒絕與他交戰。儘管如此，角色們可以指望{@creature 科斯徹奇|BGDIA}製造足夠的幹擾，將注意力從他們的活動上轉移開，無論這些活動是什麼。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If {@item smokepowder|WDH} is set on fire, dropped, or otherwise handled roughly, it explodes and deals fire damage to each creature or object within 20 feet of it: {@dice 1d6} for a handful, {@dice 9d6} for a keg. A successful {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw halves the damage. Casting {@spell dispel magic} on {@item smokepowder|WDH} renders it permanently inert.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果 {@item 發煙粉|WDH} 被點燃、掉落或處理不當，它將會爆炸並對 20 尺範圍內的每個生物或物體造成火焰傷害：少量火藥為 {@dice 1d6}，一桶火藥為 {@dice 9d6}。成功透過 {@dc 12} 敏捷豁免可使傷害減半。對 {@item 發煙粉|WDH} 施放 {@spell 解除魔法} 會使其永久失效。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A flying, double-bladed axe terrorizing passersby (the illusion-wrapped {@creature stirge} from {@area Danthelon's Dancing Axe|3bc|x})
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一把飛行的雙刃斧頭恐嚇著過路人（來自{@area 丹瑟隆的跳舞斧|3bc|x}的包裹著幻象的{@creature 蚊蝠}）

tagShapeMismatches.english: Family of {@dice 1d4} patriars ({@creature Noble||nobles}) in a coach pulled by two {@creature Draft Horse||draft horses}, with {@dice 2d6} {@creature Guard||guards} on {@creature Riding Horse||riding horses} providing escort
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 由兩名{@creature 貴族||貴族們}拉動的馬車中的{@dice 1d4}個族長（{@creature 馱用馬||矮種馬}）家族，以及騎著{@creature 警衛||警衛}提供護送的{@dice 2d6}名{@creature 乘用馬||乘用馬}

tagShapeMismatches.english: Devils like to tempt mortals with treasure and magic items. Magic items bestowed by devils usually have a devilish cast to them. They're made of infernal iron, bear Infernal script, give off faint wails of torment, smell of brimstone, or have some other telltale sign (see the {@table Special Features; What Quirk Does It Have||What Quirk Does It Have? table} in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} for examples).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 魔鬼喜歡用寶藏和魔法物品來誘惑凡人。由魔鬼賜予的魔法物品通常帶有魔鬼的特徵。它們由地獄鐵製成，刻有地獄文字，發出微弱的痛苦哀嚎，帶有硫磺的氣味，或有其他明顯的跡象（關於示例，請參閱{@book 城主指南|DMG}第7章中的{@table 特殊特性; 它有什麼怪癖？||它有什麼怪癖？表格}）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The harsh conditions of the Nine Hells can cause an infernal war machine to stop functioning properly, until it eventually breaks down. Such wear and tear can be represented using {@condition exhaustion}, as described in {@condition exhaustion||appendix A} of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, with these modifications:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 九獄嚴酷的環境可能會使得地獄戰爭機器的停止正常運作，並最終完全損毀。這種損耗可以用{@condition 力竭}狀態來體現，如《{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}》{@condition 力竭||附錄A}中所述，但做出如下變化：

numericDifferences.english: Designed for an adventuring party of four to six 1st-level characters, {@i Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus} is a Dungeons & Dragons adventure that begins in the city of Baldur's Gate and ends in Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells. By the end of the adventure, the characters should be 13th level or higher. To run this adventure, you need the fifth edition {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, and {@book Monster Manual|MM}.
numericDifferences.localized: 《{@i 博德之門：墜入阿弗納斯}》是為一支4至6名1級角色組成的冒險隊伍而設計的D&D冒險，該冒險會從博德之門的城區開始，然後結束於九獄的第一層阿弗納斯。在冒險結束時，角色們應到達13或更高的等級。為了運作這場冒險您還需要第五版的{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}、{@book 城主指南|DMG}和{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}。

numericDifferences.english: Diagram 1.1: Chapter 1 Flowchart
numericDifferences.localized: 圖1.1：第一章流程圖

numericDifferences.english: Zodge has spies who keep him informed on the characters' progress. If the characters don't visit Elfsong Tavern within forty-eight hours of receiving their orders, Zodge sends a squad of six Flaming Fist {@creature Veteran||veterans} and one {@creature flameskull} to escort the characters to the tavern, kill anyone who refuses to go, and report back to him. If the characters destroy or escape this squad, Zodge mobilizes two more squads to hunt them down.
numericDifferences.localized: 佐迪有耳目會隨時向他彙報角色們的進展。如果角色們在收到命令後的48小時內不去拜訪精靈之歌酒館的話，佐迪會派遣一支由六名焰拳{@creature Veteran||老兵}和一隻{@creature flameskull||燃焰之顱}組成的小隊去將他們護送前往精靈之歌酒館，殺掉那些不願意前往酒館的人，並隨後向他報告。如果角色們消滅或逃離了這支小隊，佐迪會再派遣兩個小隊去獵殺他們。

numericDifferences.english: No wise person walks the streets of Baldur's Gate or enters one of its taverns without a weapon or an armed escort. Anyone who has lived in the city for more than a tenday knows this from experience. Taverns might appear safe at a glance, but they are among the most dangerous places in Baldur's Gate—full of alcohol, tempting coin, and unscrupulous people. Volothamp Geddarm, a notorious raconteur known for his tavern reviews, encapsulates his Baldur's Gate experience as "hard on the stomach, especially when someone sticks a knife in there." Customers are expected to look after themselves when fights break out, and one shouldn't expect any help or sympathy from the Flaming Fist. Tavern murders are common, and usually end with the poor victim being dragged away and either left in an alley (to be picked clean by urchins, then eaten by rats) or tossed in the harbor.
numericDifferences.localized: 聰明人都不會在行走於博德之門的街道或者進出於酒館時不帶任何武器或者護衛。但凡在這個城市裡生活超過 10 天的人都有這種經驗。酒館也許乍一看是一個安全的地方，但是它實際上是博德之門最危險的地方，滿是酒精，誘人的錢幣，粗鄙之人。瓦羅譚普·哲達，一個以其酒館評價而臭名昭著的故事大王將其在博德之門的經歷概述為"傷胃，特別是當有人把刀刺在那兒的時候"。當打鬥爆發時顧客最好靠他自己，而不該指望焰拳的同情。酒館謀殺是很常見的，而被拖出去的可憐受害者的下場要麼是被丟棄在小巷裡（被頑童扒光之後再成為鼠食）要麼被拋進海港。

numericDifferences.english: Dead-Eye's ship, the {@i Uncivil Serpent}, is moored at the end of a dock on the east side of the harbor. Eleven {@creature Bandit||bandits} guard it, and no treasure is kept aboard. If the characters dispose of all the pirates, the ship is theirs for the taking, though it requires a crew of twenty to sail, and half or more of the crew must have proficiency with water vehicles.
numericDifferences.localized: 死眼的船，{@i 狂野大蛇號}，停靠在東部港口的一個船塢盡頭。11 個{@creature Bandit||匪徒}守衛著那裡，而且船上沒有任何的寶藏。如果角色解決掉了所有的海盜，那麼他們就可以奪取那艘船，但是它需要 20 個船員才能起航，並且其中一半的人需要具有水運載具的熟練項。

numericDifferences.english: The chamber at the bottom of the staircase is empty, unlit, and flooded with foul-smelling water to a depth of 2 feet (see "Dungeon Features" below for more information).
numericDifferences.localized: 樓梯底部的房間是空蕩蕩而無光照的，並且被深約兩尺的臭烘烘的汙水所淹沒（請參閱下面的"地城特性"以獲取更多資訊）。

numericDifferences.english: The back wall of this dry alcove is hung with a 5-foot-wide, 7-foot-tall tapestry. It depicts a grisly scene of four faceless figures ripping apart a fifth figure, who is screaming. Characters who inspect the tapestry without touching it notice yellow mold growing around its edges. In fact, a 5-foot-square patch of {@hazard yellow mold} (see {@hazard yellow mold||chapter 5 of the Dungeon Master's Guide}) clings to the back of the tapestry and releases its deadly spores if the tapestry is disturbed.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個乾燥凹室的後壁上掛著一張寬五尺長七尺的掛毯。掛毯上描繪著個四個無麵人將第五個慘叫的人四分五裂的可怕場景。嘗試觀察掛毯的角色可以在不觸控掛毯的情況下發現它邊緣的黃色黴菌。實際上一片覆蓋五尺的{@hazard yellow mold||黃黴菌}（請參閱{@hazard yellow mold||《城主指南》第五章}）依附在掛毯的背面，並且如果掛毯被弄亂，它就會釋放出致命的孢子。

numericDifferences.english: Flennis is preparing to make a zombie out of the corpse on the table, but the {@spell animate dead} spell takes 1 minute to cast, which means she must deal with the characters first. Her {@creature skeletal rats|BGDIA} attack the nearest foe, and she casts spells while using the table for cover.
numericDifferences.localized: 福尼斯正準備將桌子上的屍體轉換成殭屍，但是{@spell animate dead||活化死屍}需要一分鐘的時間來施展，所以她必須得先解決角色們。她的{@creature skeletal rats|BGDIA|骷髏鼠}會攻擊最近的敵人而她自己則會依靠桌子為掩體進行施法。

numericDifferences.english: If one or more of the black candles on the altar are lit, they shed a green light that reveals black writing on the walls. The writing, which is not visible otherwise, says in Common, "RISE AND BE COUNTED!" If these words are spoken aloud within 5 feet of the altar, the words vanish as bones hidden under the debris at the north end of the room rise up and knit together, forming three animated human {@creature Skeleton||skeletons}. The skeletons are evil undead, but they obey the commands of whoever spoke the words that raised them, serving that individual until they're destroyed or their master is killed.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果祭壇上有任何一隻或者超過一隻蠟燭被點燃了，它們會發出綠光並且照亮牆上所書寫的黑色文字。牆上的文字除此之外在任何情況下都不可見。文字是通用語寫的"甦醒，現身！"如果有人在距離祭壇五尺之內大聲說出這些話，北側廢墟下埋藏的白骨就會飛出並排列組合形成三具活動的人類{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}，之後文字會消失。這些骷髏是邪惡的不死生物，但他們會聽從那個將他們召喚出來的人的命令，他們會在被摧毀或者主人死亡前一直服務於他。

numericDifferences.english: The shambling corpses are six {@creature Zombie||zombies} created by Flennis (see {@adventure area D13|BGDIA|1|D13. Morgue}) from the remains of the Dead Three cultists' murder victims. The zombies obey only their creator and attack all others, including other members of the Dead Three cult.
numericDifferences.localized: 這些蹣跚的屍體是 6 具{@creature Zombie||喪屍}，他們是福尼斯（詳見{@adventure 區域D13|BGDIA|1|D13. Morgue}）用死亡三神教徒所謀殺的受害者的屍體製造的。這些殭屍只聽命於他們的創造者，並且會攻擊其他任何人，就算是其他死亡三神的教徒也不例外。

numericDifferences.english: This ten-foot-wide flooded passage is braced at regular intervals by wooden beams. Old torch stubs float on the murky water. At the point where the tunnel bends west toward {@adventure area D29|BGDIA|1|D29. Mortlock Vanthampur}, the characters hear echoes of a battle unfolding in that location.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個 10 尺寬的淹水通道是由幾根間隔的木樑所支撐的。破舊的火把頭漂浮在汙水上。當角色們到達通向{@adventure 區域D29|BGDIA|1|D29. Mortlock Vanthampur}的西向拐角時，他們會聽到那邊傳過來戰鬥的聲音。

numericDifferences.english: The man with the greatclub is twenty-nine-year-old {@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA}, who has 30 hit points left. His opponent is an uninjured {@creature death's head of Bhaal|BGDIA} named Vaaz. Four other Dead Three cultists lie dead in the water, their skulls caved in by Mortlock.
numericDifferences.localized: 拿著大棒的男人是正是 29 歲的{@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA|摩特洛克·範薩姆普爾}，他只剩下 30 HP了。而他的對手卻是一名沒有受傷的{@creature death's head of Bhaal|BGDIA|巴爾的死神之首}，他的名字叫做瓦茲。還有其他四個死亡三神的教徒的屍體漂浮在水裡，他們的腦袋都被摩特洛克砸扁了。

numericDifferences.english: Six of the crates are empty except for packing straw. The other three contain stolen goods that the cultists have not yet disbursed, including ten days' worth of rations, a {@item Caltrops (bag of 20)|PHB|bag of twenty caltrops}, three {@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|flasks of alchemist's fire}, six sets of {@item manacles|PHB}, four {@item Tinderbox|PHB|tinderboxes}, nine {@item Dagger|PHB|daggers}, and four {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing} in glass vials.
numericDifferences.localized: 其中六個箱子裡除了稻草外一無所有，剩下三個裡面放著那些教徒還沒有來得及分贓的貨物，包括 10 天的口糧，一包共{@item Caltrops (bag of 20)|PHB|裝有二十個鐵蒺藜的小包}，三瓶{@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|熾火膠}，六套{@item manacles|PHB|鐐銬}，四個{@item Tinderbox|PHB|火絨盒}，九把{@item Dagger|PHB|匕首}和四瓶裝在玻璃瓶的{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}。

numericDifferences.english: As you emerge from the bathhouse, five figures leap down from the top of the courtyard wall to confront you. In addition to their black leather armor, they wear strange masks and cloaks that give each of them a vaguely dragon-like appearance. All five brandish curved steel blades reminiscent of dragon claws.
numericDifferences.localized: 當你們從公共浴室中出現的時候，5 個黑影從庭院的牆上躍下，來到了你們的面前。他們都穿著黑色的皮甲，帶著奇怪的面具和披風，這些東西使他們看起來有些龍類的影子。這五個人都揮舞著讓人想起龍爪的彎曲的鋼刀。

numericDifferences.english: Characters who clear out the Dungeon of the Dead Three might encounter more servants of Bane, Bhaal, or Myrkul in other parts of Baldur's Gate. These villains (see {@adventure appendix D|BGDIA|13}) usually operate as mixed groups of Banites, Bhaalites, and Myrkulites. Here are a few appropriate encounters for a party of four or five characters of 3rd to 5th level:
numericDifferences.localized: 角色們在清理完的地牢後，可能在博德之門的其他區域遭遇到這些教徒們。這些惡黨（請參閱{@adventure 附錄D|BGDIA|13}），通常都是由班恩，巴爾，米爾寇的信徒們混合而成。以下是幾個適合一支 4 到 5 人，3 至 5 級的小隊的遭遇：

numericDifferences.english: Fog obscures the Low Lantern until you get within a hundred feet of it, whereupon its tall masts and creaking bulk come into view. The converted ship has rigging but no sails, and is anchored to the wharf by thick chains. A wooden staircase climbs from the wharf's edge to the main deck. A lantern at the bow casts an eerie green light to signify that the tavern is open for business.
numericDifferences.localized: 當你們離它僅有 100 尺時，你們才發現了這間被濃霧所籠罩的矮提燈酒館，它高聳的桅杆和嘎吱作響的巨大船體隨之映入眼簾。這艘被改造的船留著索具但是已經沒有帆了，粗大的鐵鏈將它錨定在停泊處。一個木質樓梯從港口通向它的主甲板。船首的提燈散發出詭異的綠光來表示著這個酒館正在營業中。

numericDifferences.english: This tavern lounge fills an entire deck and is lit by oil lanterns hanging from the 8-foot-high ceiling by 1-foot-long chains. The windowless deck contains a bar, couches, coffee tables, and tables where patrons can socialize and gamble. Three of Laraelra's bouncers ({@creature Thug||thugs}) stand in plain view across the deck.
numericDifferences.localized: 這一整層船艙都是酒館休息室，八尺高的天花板上用一尺長的鐵鏈吊著著照明用的油燈，這層無窗的船艙裡有著一個吧檯，許多沙發和咖啡桌，還有給客人們用來社交和賭博的桌子。拉瑞娜的三個保鏢（{@creature Thug||暴徒}）會站在可以清楚看見整個甲板的地方。

numericDifferences.english: Unless the characters attack him at once, Amrik assumes they've come to him for a loan. He is more than happy to provide one, up to a limit of 150 gp (the amount currently carried by his bodyguard Vhaltus). Amrik's terms are simple: he expects repayment in a tenday and charges 25 percent interest on the loan. As a member of the influential Vanthampur family, Amrik has plenty of muscle he can bring to bear against anyone who defaults on a loan, and his family's influence extends beyond Baldur's Gate.
numericDifferences.localized: 除非角色們在一開始就攻擊阿姆利克，否則他會認為角色們是來找他借貸的，他會很高興的提供一筆不超過 150GP 的貸款（他的保鏢瓦爾圖斯目前所攜帶的金額）。阿姆利克的條件十分簡單：他要在 10 天內收回這筆錢同時收取 25% 的利息。作為位高權重的範薩姆普爾家族中的一員，阿姆利克有充足的勢力對付那些不願意還錢的人，而他家族的影響力也遠遠不僅限於博德之門內。

numericDifferences.english: Born in the land of Turmish, Reya came to the holy city of Elturel to train as a Hellrider when she was twelve. As a faithful follower of Torm, Reya is prepared and has trained to sacrifice herself for the greater good.
numericDifferences.localized: 蕾婭出生於圖米斯，然後她在 12 歲的時候來到了聖城埃爾託瑞爾接受成為地獄騎手的訓練。作為託姆的虔誠信徒，蕾婭早已準備並接受訓練來為更偉大的事業而犧牲自己。

numericDifferences.english: Twenty {@creature Guard||guards} of the Watch vigilantly are posted at every gate to the Upper City. If the characters present the badges given to them by Captain Zodge, the Watch members let them pass through the gates, even if they are accompanied by a prisoner or a known fugitive such as Reya Mantlemorn. Any character without a badge is questioned and required to pay a gate toll of 2 cp.
numericDifferences.localized: 每個通往上城區的城門都有20名戒備的警備隊{@creature Guard||警衛}在那裡進行警戒。如果角色們向他們展示佐迪隊長給他們的徽章的話，警備隊就會讓他們透過，就算他們身邊挾制著囚徒或跟著像蕾婭·曼特莫恩這樣的通緝犯也不例外。任何沒有徽章的角色都會被盤問並要求支付2CP的通行費。

numericDifferences.english: Thalamra is a widow three times over, and each of her dead husbands was kind enough to give her a son. Her oldest boy, Thurstwell, is a pale and sullen recluse in his forties. A veritable shut-in, he uses imps to spy on his brothers, Amrik and Mortlock. Thurstwell resents both of them—Amrik for being their mother's favorite, and Mortlock for being a monstrous dolt.
numericDifferences.localized: 薩拉瑪拉已經接連喪偶三次，但她的每一任丈夫都給她留下了一個兒子。她的大兒子，瑟斯維爾，是一個40多歲，面色蒼白又沉悶的隱居者。他是一個十足的孤僻者，他用小魔鬼來監視他的兄弟們，阿姆利克和摩特洛克。瑟斯維爾憎惡他們——阿姆利克是他母親的最愛，而摩特洛克是一個醜惡笨蛋。

numericDifferences.english: The villa's wooden doors and lead-framed windows aren't locked, and the Vanthampurs employ guards to patrol the yard (see {@area area V1|09c|x}). The guards live elsewhere and change shifts every six hours.
numericDifferences.localized: 別墅裡面的木門和鉛製框架的窗戶都沒有上鎖，範薩姆普爾家族僱了守衛在院子裡巡邏（請參閱{@area 區域V1|09c|x}）。這些守衛住在別的地方並且每 6 小時換一班。

numericDifferences.english: The Vanthampurs employ four full-time live-in servants (all neutral human {@creature Commoner||commoners}):
numericDifferences.localized: 範薩姆普爾家族僱傭了 4 名全職的住家僕人（全部都是絕對中立人類{@creature Commoner||平民}）。

numericDifferences.english: Fendrick Gray, a decrepit seventy-year-old butler
numericDifferences.localized: 芬德里克·格雷，一個 70 歲的男性老管家。

numericDifferences.english: Sarvinder Peck, a salty fifty-two-year-old groundskeeper and stable master
numericDifferences.localized: 沙文德·佩克，52 歲、說話粗獷的園丁兼馬廄主管

numericDifferences.english: Gabourey D'Vaelan, a fussy thirty-five-year-old cook
numericDifferences.localized: 加博雷·德'瓦蘭，一個挑剔的 35 歲廚子。

numericDifferences.english: Ambra Fallwater, a plainspoken nineteen-year-old maid
numericDifferences.localized: 安布拉·費爾沃特，一個大嘴巴的 19 歲女僕。

numericDifferences.english: Nine lawful evil human {@creature Guard||guards} patrol the yard in three groups of three. When the characters first arrive, these groups are located at the points marked "V1" on {@adventure map 1.5|BGDIA|1|Map 1.5: Vanthampur Villa}, and are circling the yard counterclockwise.
numericDifferences.localized: 9 名守序邪惡人類{@creature Guard||警衛}分成三個三人組在這個院子裡巡邏。當角色們一開始到達這裡的時候，他們所處的位置正如{@adventure 地圖 1.5|BGDIA|1|Map 1.5: Vanthampur Villa}中的"V1"所示，並且圍繞著院子逆時針巡邏。

numericDifferences.english: This stone building contains stables for four {@creature Draft Horse||draft horses}, plus a fully equipped smithy with an anvil and a hearth. Sarvinder Peck (see "{@area Servants|09a|x}" above) can be encountered here, making and fitting new shoes for the horses.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個石質建築裡面有4匹{@creature Draft Horse||馱用馬}，裡面還有一個裝置完善的鐵匠鋪，鐵砧熔爐一應俱全。在這裡可以遇到沙文德·佩克（請參閱上文的"{@area 僕人|09a|x}"），他正在給馬打造和安裝新的馬蹄鐵。

numericDifferences.english: A 3-foot-square flagstone in the southwest corner of the stable doubles as a hidden trapdoor in the floor. Any character who searches the area finds the trapdoor with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The stone covers a brick-walled shaft and a wooden ladder that descends 15 feet to {@area area V27|0cf|x} of the dungeon. If the Vanthampurs need to flee the dungeon, they can use the trapdoor to reach their horses quickly.
numericDifferences.localized: 在馬廄西南角有一個三尺見方的石板那是一扇隱藏的門。角色們可以透過一個 {@dc 15} 的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定以找到陷板門。石板掩藏著一口帶著木頭梯子的磚砌深井，下深 15 尺，直到地城的區域{@area 區域V27|0cf|x}。如果範薩姆普爾家族的人想要逃出地城，他們可以透過這個陷板門快速到達馬廄。

numericDifferences.english: Apart from the main entrance, this room has two exits. A plaster shelf lined with ornate vases circles the room at a height of nine feet. Spread across the flagstone floor is a ten-foot-wide, fifteen-foot-long rug of exquisite design, depicting a royal coronation. Two tapestries hanging on the walls depict a dragon flying over a ship and pilgrims on camels, respectively.
numericDifferences.localized: 除了大門以外，這個房間還有兩個出入口。一條 9 尺高的石膏架環繞著房間，上面陳列著華麗的花瓶。石質的地板上鋪著一個 10 尺寬，15 尺長的精美地毯，上面描繪的是皇室的加冕儀式。牆上掛著兩幅掛毯分別繪著一條巨龍掠過船隻以及朝聖者駝隊的場景。

numericDifferences.english: Four {@condition invisible} {@creature Imp||imps} lurk among the vases on the high shelf, one in each corner. The imps swoop down to attack anyone they perceive as intruders, including characters who have Mortlock or Amrik as a prisoner.
numericDifferences.localized: 房間四角的高架上的花瓶上分別藏著 4 只{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature Imp||小魔鬼}。這些小魔鬼會衝下來攻擊任何被他們視作入侵者的人，包括那些挾制摩特洛克和阿姆利克，當他們成犯人對待的角色。

numericDifferences.english: The vases, rug, and tapestries are valuable art objects, though they don't go well together. Each of the sixteen vases weighs 2 pounds and is worth 25 gp. The rug weighs 50 pounds and is worth 250 gp. Each of the two tapestries weighs 5 pounds and is worth 75 gp.
numericDifferences.localized: 地毯，花瓶和掛毯都是值錢的藝術品，但它們放在一起看並不怎麼搭。16 個花瓶每個都有兩磅重，值 25 GP。地毯重 50 磅，價值 250 GP，兩個掛毯每個重 5 磅，價值 75 GP。

numericDifferences.english: This undecorated room contains four single beds and a dining table for the manor's servants. The servants keep spare uniforms and other personal belongings in drawers under their beds. Nothing of value is kept here.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個樸素的房間裡，放著 4 張單人床和一張餐桌。僕人們把他們自己的制服和其他的私人物品放在床下的抽屜裡。這裡沒有什麼值錢的東西。

numericDifferences.english: Thalamra Vanthampur and her sons gather here once a tenday for an always-tense family dinner. Read the following when the characters can see this area:
numericDifferences.localized: 薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾和她的兒子們每隔 10 天會聚在這裡進行一次氣氛總是很緊張的家庭晚宴，當角色抵達該區域時做出以下描述：

numericDifferences.english: The cabinet contains a set of eight red crystal goblets (25 gp each) and sixteen bottles of wine. Fifteen of the bottles contain fine wine (10 gp each). The last bottle is laced with {@item Midnight Tears}, a tasteless poison (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). This tainted bottle is set aside for guests whom the duke intends to eliminate.
numericDifferences.localized: 酒櫃裡放著一套 8 個水晶高腳杯（每個 25 GP）和16瓶酒。其中的 15 瓶都是佳釀（每個 10 GP）剩下一個繫著花邊的瓶子裡面裝的是{@item Midnight Tears||午夜之淚}，一種無味的毒藥（詳情請見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第8章{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}），這瓶毒酒是公爵為那些她想要除掉的客人而準備的。

numericDifferences.english: Five lawful evil human {@creature Guard||guards} stand watch here—one by each door. They attack anyone not accompanied by a Vanthampur family member. If they hear trouble elsewhere, the guards can't be {@status surprised}, but they stay put unless ordered to move by a member of the family. Combat here alerts {@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA} in {@area area V13|0af|x}.
numericDifferences.localized: 5 名守序邪惡人類{@creature Guard||警衛}看守著這裡，他們分別站在每扇門邊。他們會攻擊任何在沒有範薩姆普爾家族成員陪伴而進入該區域的人。如果他們聽到別的地方發生了麻煩，那麼警衛就不會被{@status surprised||突襲}，但他們也不會在沒有其他範薩姆普爾家族成員命令下離開這裡。這裡發生的戰鬥會讓{@area 區域V13|0af|x}的{@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA|瑟斯維爾·範薩姆普爾}警惕。

numericDifferences.english: Drab curtains cover the windows of this plain room, which contains a bed, a padlocked iron chest, a claw-footed iron bathtub, and a fireplace. Standing in the middle of the room is {@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA}, a frail and hateful forty-two-year-old man clutching an {@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA} (see "Treasure" below). If alerted to intruders, Thurstwell has locked the puzzle box in the iron chest and tucked the key into his robe pocket.
numericDifferences.localized: 淡褐色窗簾覆蓋著這個樸素房間所有的窗戶，房間裡擺了一張床，一個帶有掛鎖的鐵箱子，一口爪足鐵浴缸，和一座壁爐。房間中間站著的就是{@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA|瑟斯維爾·範薩姆普爾}，一個瘦弱且令人生厭的 42 歲男子，手裡拿著一個{@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA|煉獄謎盒}（詳情請見下文）。如果他察覺到有入侵者，瑟斯維爾會把謎盒鎖到鐵箱子裡去，然後把鑰匙放到自己長袍的口袋裡。

numericDifferences.english: This tastefully appointed room contains a bed, a side table, a claw-footed iron bathtub, a fireplace, and an iron-banded wooden chest. A three-foot-wide, six-foot-tall mirror is mounted to the east wall opposite the fireplace. The mirror's varnished wooden frame is carved with images of rats, ravens, and spiders.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個雅緻的房間裡放著一張床，一張邊桌，一口爪足鐵浴缸，一座壁爐，和一個帶鐵箍的木箱，一面 3 尺寬 6 尺高的落地鏡固定在壁爐對面的東牆上。這個鏡子的漆木邊框上雕刻著老鼠，烏鴉，和蜘蛛的圖案。

numericDifferences.english: The vanity holds six bottles of fine perfume (20 gp each), a silver hairbrush inlaid with lapis lazuli (100 gp), and a wooden jewelry box with electrum filigree (75 gp) holding a pearl necklace (250 gp), a platinum cameo shaped like a winged cat (50 gp), and two {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing} in thin crystal vials.
numericDifferences.localized: 這裡有 6 瓶優質的香水（每瓶 20 GP），一把鑲青金石銀髮刷（100 GP），一個盤琥珀金絲木首飾盒（75 GP）裡面放著一串珍珠項鍊（250 GP），一個翼貓白金浮雕（50 GP），兩瓶水晶瓶裝的{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}。

numericDifferences.english: The chest has a false bottom underlaid with metal springs. The combined weight of the items in the chest holds the false bottom down, but if three or more items are removed, the false bottom rises and pulls the cork out of a thin glass vial hidden underneath it. The uncorked vial releases a cloud of poisonous gas that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the chest. The cloud is stationary and lasts for 1 minute, or until it's dispersed by a strong wind. Any creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 11 ({@dice 2d10}) poison damage.
numericDifferences.localized: 箱子的底部有一個活板，下面有一個金屬彈簧。這個活板承擔箱內所有物品的重量，但如果有三件或者更多的物件被拿出來的話，活板會彈出來同時拉掉藏在活板下的細玻璃瓶的木塞，被開啟的玻璃瓶會以木箱為中心釋放一個十尺半徑的毒霧，毒霧會持續一分鐘，或直到被強風吹散。任何在毒霧中開始回合的生物必須透過一次{@dc 13}的體質豁免，豁免失敗則遭受 11（{@dice 2d10}）的毒素傷害。

numericDifferences.english: Duke Vanthampur abhors reading but keeps a modest library of fine literature for the sake of appearances. Her study contains two hundred books. A character who spends 1 hour sifting through the collection can find twenty rare first editions (25 gp each). The remaining books are worth 5 gp each to interested buyers, except for a worthless book titled {@i Last Charge of the Hellriders}. A cavity cut into its pages holds a small iron ring with two keys hanging from it. These keys unlock the cages in area V19.
numericDifferences.localized: 範薩姆普爾公爵雖然十分討厭讀書，但是擁有一個不大但是有優質藏書的閱覽室有助於塑造形象。她的書房裡藏有兩百多本書，如果角色在這裡消耗一個小時搜尋的話，他們可以發現 20 本稀有的初版書籍（每本 25 GP），剩下的書可以以每本 5 GP的價格被感興趣的買家收購。除此之外還有一本無價之寶，標題是{@i 地獄騎手的最後衝鋒}。書本被打了一個洞，裡面套著一個鐵環，上面掛著兩把鑰匙。這兩把鑰匙可以用來開啟區域 V19 的籠子。

numericDifferences.english: The spiral staircase climbs fifteen feet to a square room with crisscrossing rafters ten feet overhead and a peaked roof above that. An empty bookcase dominates the west wall, and two filthy padlocked cages stand on the floor. Each cage holds a human prisoner and a chamberpot.
numericDifferences.localized: 螺旋狀的樓梯升高 15 尺到達了這個小房間，頭頂 10 尺便是交錯的屋椽和屋脊。西牆被一個空著的書架所佔據，兩個骯髒的掛鎖籠子立在地板上，每個裡面都關了一個人類囚犯和一個尿壺。

numericDifferences.english: Six of the barrels contain drinking water, and six contain ale.
numericDifferences.localized: 有 6 個桶裝了飲用水，而另外的 6 個則裝著麥酒。

numericDifferences.english: More than two hundred corked bottles of wine are displayed in seven-foot-tall wooden racks that span the west and south walls. Empty wooden crates are stacked in the middle of the room.
numericDifferences.localized: 七尺高的木架橫跨西牆和南牆，上面陳列著超過 200 瓶塞著木塞的葡萄酒。房子的中間堆著空木箱。

numericDifferences.english: Seventeen of the bottles contain fine wine (10 gp per bottle). The remaining wines on display are common vintages (1 sp per bottle).
numericDifferences.localized: 有 17 瓶上等葡萄酒（10 GP每瓶），剩下的都是普通葡萄酒（1 SP每瓶）。

numericDifferences.english: The Vanthampurs store animal carcasses and other fresh meat in this room. Hanging in the middle of the room from the 10-foot-high ceiling are six 3-foot-long chains, each ending in a hook. Flayed boar carcasses hang from four of the hooks, while the remaining two hooks are bare.
numericDifferences.localized: 範薩姆普爾家族將動物的屍體和其他新鮮肉類儲存在這個房間。這個房間中間 10 尺高的天花板上，掛著 6 根三尺長的鐵鏈，每一根的末尾都有一個鐵鉤。其中 4 根鐵鉤掛著一個被剝皮的野豬屍體，剩下兩根鉤子則什麼都沒有掛。

numericDifferences.english: The cultists dine here, though none are present when the characters first arrive. Two wooden trestle tables with benches stand in the middle of the room, which is brightly lit by six tall wrought-iron candlesticks spaced along the walls. Each candlestick stands six feet high and has nine lit candles at the top of it.
numericDifferences.localized: 教徒們會在這裡用餐，但是當角色們第一次抵達時，這裡不會有任何人。房子的中間放著兩張帶長椅的擱板桌，沿著牆還放著 6 個鍛鐵高燭臺。每個燭臺都有 6 尺高，上面點著 9 根蠟燭。

numericDifferences.english: A character who listens at the double door or one of the secret doors leading to this room hears a half dozen humanoid voices chanting in Infernal. Characters who listen to the chants and understand that language can discern praise heaped upon the archdevil Zariel for her tireless effort to win the Blood War.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果有角色在大門或者是另一扇通往這個房間的密門上偷聽的話，他可以聽到大概有 6 個類人生物的聲音正在使用煉獄語進行禱告。如果角色進行了竊聽且理解這門語言的話，他們可以聽出這是對魔鬼大公扎瑞爾為贏得血戰而付出的不懈努力的讚美。

numericDifferences.english: Two rows of tall wrought-iron candlesticks light this vaulted chamber, each one bearing nine flickering candles. A seven-foot-tall statue of an angel with white glowing eyes and a longsword stands atop a dais to the south. A six-foot-tall fiend bristling with spines stands west of the statue, glaring at four black-robed cultists who kneel and chant in the middle of the room, their faces hidden behind golden devil masks. Nine tapestries depicting the layers of the Nine Hells adorn the walls.
numericDifferences.localized: 兩排鍛鐵高燭臺照亮了這個房間，每個燭臺上都有 9 根燃燒的蠟燭。房間南端的高臺上矗立著一尊手持長劍眼放白光高達七尺的天使雕像。在雕像的西側站著的是一個 6 尺高，渾身尖刺豎立的魔鬼，他正瞪著跪在房間中間禱告的 4 名黑袍教徒，他們的臉為黃金面具所遮蓋。牆上裝飾著 9 張描繪著九獄各層景象的掛毯。

numericDifferences.english: The spined fiend is a {@creature barbed devil} named Odious. Sent by Zariel to serve Duke Vanthampur, the devil answers only to those two. The chanting figures are four lawful evil human {@creature Cultist||cultists} wearing black robes and golden devil masks similar to those worn by the cultists in {@area area V22|0c5|x}. The devil and the cultists attack intruders on sight, but can be duped by characters wearing disguises (see the "{@area Disguised Characters|0cb|x}" sidebar).
numericDifferences.localized: 這個{@creature barbed devil||蝟魔}名叫歐迪沃斯，他是扎瑞爾派來服侍範薩姆普爾公爵的，這個魔鬼只聽命於他們兩個人。在進行禱告的是 4 名人類守序邪惡{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}，他們穿著黑袍，戴著金色面具和{@area 區域V22|0c5|x}中的教徒十分相似。魔鬼和教徒會攻擊他們看到的入侵者，但是角色們可以透過偽裝來矇混過關（詳情請見{@area 偽裝的角色|0cb|x}）。

numericDifferences.english: This room is lit by a pair of tall wrought-iron candlesticks in the northeast and southeast corners. Nine candles burn atop each one, casting flickering light across a claw-footed altar carved from a single block of obsidian, and which has a small angel-shaped flame erupting from its top. A gray-haired woman kneels before the altar.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個房間被東南角和東北角的兩隻鍛鐵燭臺所照亮。每個燭臺上都有 9 根蠟燭，閃爍的燭光灑在一座用整塊黑曜石雕琢而成的爪足祭壇上，祭壇頂端冒出天使形狀的火焰。一名灰髮女人跪在祭壇前方。

numericDifferences.english: Two of the cells (your choice) contain prisoners. The other four cells are empty, though captured characters might end up here (see the "{@area Imprisoned Characters|0d8|x}" sidebar). If you need to introduce a new party member to replace one who died, that character can begin the adventure locked in one of the empty cells.
numericDifferences.localized: 有兩個牢房（由你選擇）裝有犯人，剩下的4個則是空的，而那些被逮捕的角色，也可能被關在這裡（詳情請見"{@area 被囚禁的角色|0d8|x}"）。如果你需要引入一位新的角色，來替代那些死亡的角色，這個角色可以從其中一個空的牢房裡開始新的冒險。

numericDifferences.english: The first prisoner is a short, lean, erudite male human in his fifties named Falaster Fisk. Originally from Calimshan, Falaster is a neutral {@creature spy} with no weapons. He speaks Common and Infernal, wears an ankle-length caftan, and has dark hair. His neatly trimmed goatee beard is dyed crimson.
numericDifferences.localized: 第1位囚犯是一名矮小，精瘦，博學，五十多歲的人類男性，他叫福萊斯特·菲斯克。他出生於卡林珊，福萊斯特是一名中立{@creature spy||間諜}，沒有攜帶任何武器。他會說通用語和煉獄語，穿著一件及踝束腰長袍，有著黑色頭髮。他修剪整齊的黑色山羊鬍被染成了深紅色。

numericDifferences.english: The second prisoner is a fit, aristocratic human woman in her seventies named Lady Satiir Thione-Hhune. Born into the rich and politically powerful Hhune patriar family, Satiir is a neutral evil {@creature noble} with no weapons or armor (AC 11). She was kidnapped by the Vanthampurs to be used as leverage in the event that the Hhunes find out who stole the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} from their family's crypt.
numericDifferences.localized: 第 2 位囚犯是一位 70 多歲，身體健康，有貴族氣質的人類女性，被稱為薩蒂爾•席歐尼•胡內夫人。她出生於富有而且權傾朝野的胡內宗貴家族，薩蒂爾是一名中立邪惡{@creature noble||貴族}，沒有攜帶任何的武器或護甲（AC 11）。範薩姆普爾家族綁架她來用作當胡內家族發現是誰從他們的家族墓地裡偷出{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}時的籌碼。

numericDifferences.english: Four wooden wardrobes stand against the walls in this area. The cultists store their robes and masks in these wardrobes before leaving the dungeon and returning to the city above. The wardrobes along the west wall stand empty. Characters who search the wardrobe on the south wall find four sets of black robes and four gold devil masks, as worn by the cultists encountered elsewhere in the dungeon.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個房間的牆邊立著 4 個木質衣櫃，教徒們會在他們離開地城返回上方的城市之前，將他們的長袍和麵具放在這些衣櫃裡。西牆邊的衣櫃是空著的，如果角色們搜尋南邊的衣櫃的話，他們會發現 4 套長袍和 4 個金魔鬼薄面具，這些東西和地城其他地方遇到的教徒們穿的是一樣的。

numericDifferences.english: Ten {@creature Cultist||cultists} gather here, minus any cultists defeated in {@area area V22|0c5|x}. These cult members are lawful evil humans wearing black robes and thin gold devil masks. Some have dozed off, while others are sitting on their beds, sharing rumors regarding {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}'s hand in the fall of Elturel and Duke Vanthampur's plans for Baldur's Gate. These cultists show intruders no quarter.
numericDifferences.localized: 這裡一共聚集了 10 名{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}，但是要減去在{@area 區域V22|0c5|x}所擊敗的教徒數量。這些教徒都是守序邪惡人類，穿著黑色的長袍戴著金色的面具。他們中的有些人正在打盹，其他人還坐在他們的床邊討論著關於{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}在埃爾託瑞爾的隕落和範薩姆普爾公爵的計劃中的作用的流言。這些教徒會毫不留情的攻擊入侵者。

numericDifferences.english: This room contains four wooden tables with two small wooden coffers atop each one. Hanging on the wall opposite the door is a beautiful golden shield. Standing in front of the shield is an old man in plain garments, carrying a lit candlestick. As he turns to face the door, you see that his shadow on the far wall doesn't match his form, but appears to be the shadow of a pudgy, horned fiend with small wings.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個房間裡放著 4 張木桌，每張桌子上放著兩個木質的保險箱。門對面的牆上掛著一面華麗的金色盾牌。盾牌前面站著一個穿著普通衣服的老年男性，手裡拿著一盞點亮的燭臺。當他轉身看一下門的時候，你會發現他映在遠處牆上的影子並不符合他的身型，那個陰影看上去更像一個矮胖帶翼的長角魔鬼。

numericDifferences.english: The eight coffers are unlocked and contain money belonging to the Vanthampur family, as well as treasure stolen from Tiamat's hoard on Avernus. Duke Vanthampur plans to use this combined treasure to bribe the city's patriars and government officials into supporting her bid to become the new grand duke.
numericDifferences.localized: 8 個保險箱都並未上鎖，裡面裝著範薩姆普爾家族的財富，也包括他們從阿弗納斯的提亞馬特寶藏中偷來的財物。範薩姆普爾公爵打算使用這些寶藏來賄賂城市中的宗貴和政府官員來支援她成為下一任大公。

numericDifferences.english: Coffer 8 contains twenty azurite gemstones (10 gp each) stolen from Tiamat's hoard.
numericDifferences.localized: 8 號保險箱放著 20 個石青寶石（10 GP），這些是從提亞馬特寶藏那裡偷來的。

numericDifferences.english: "Commander Portyr!" says Zodge. "I was told you wouldn't be in Baldur's Gate for at least another tenday."
numericDifferences.localized: "波提爾指揮官！"佐迪說道，"我聽說您至少 10 天之內都不會出現在博德之門。"

numericDifferences.english: Use a character's passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score to determine whether a theft made against that character is successful. If the character's score is 11 or higher, the theft is detected and thwarted. Otherwise, the thief makes off with one item weighing 1 pound or less (such as a coin pouch or potion) and disappears into the crowd before the theft is noticed. If a character is robbed, ask the player what small items the character is carrying, then decide which of those items was stolen.
numericDifferences.localized: 使用角色的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）來決定針對這名角色的扒竊是否成功，如果角色的檢定結果等於或高於11，那麼小偷就會被發現並被阻止。否則這名小偷會偷走一件重量為一磅或者更少的東西（比如錢包或者是藥水）並且在被發現前消失在擁擠的街道中。如果角色被偷了的話，詢問問角色手裡有哪些小物件，然後決定哪一個東西被偷了。

numericDifferences.english: As Wyrm's Crossing and Baldur's Gate disappear from view, you find yourselves heading down the Coast Way, a dirt road that leads to such distant lands as Tethyr, Amn, and Calimshan. Candlekeep lies some one hundred and fifty miles south and west—a five-day journey.
numericDifferences.localized: 當飛龍渡和博德之門逐漸消失在你們視野裡的時候，你們發現自己已經走上了灣岸公路，這條泥濘的道路會通向遙遠的泰瑟爾、安姆、卡林珊。燭堡就坐落於大約西南方向 150 英里的地方——這大概會需要花上 5 天。

numericDifferences.english: If Reya Mantlemorn is with the characters, she shares the following tale over a campfire at some point during the characters' five-day journey to Candlekeep:
numericDifferences.localized: 如果蕾婭·曼特莫恩，在角色隊伍中，她會在這 5 天旅途中的某個時間點上角色們介紹地獄騎手的故事：

numericDifferences.english: Thirty people can dine here comfortably at any time. The Hearth is always open, and the fire is never permitted to go out. A dozen patrons typically occupy the pub during the day, with more during lunch and supper.
numericDifferences.localized: 任何時候這裡都可以容納 30 人在這裡舒適的用餐。壁爐堂是全天營業的，而且篝火永遠不會熄滅。通常都會有一打的顧客在酒館裡，而午餐和晚飯時間則會更多。

numericDifferences.english: Inside the box is a stack of nine chain-linked plates, each three inches on a side, cast of dark iron, and stamped with Infernal runes. Anyone who understands Infernal can translate the runes as follows:
numericDifferences.localized: 盒子裡面放著的是一堆 9 個用鎖鏈捆住的平板，每個每條邊都有三吋長，由黑鐵鑄成，上面銘刻著煉獄語的符文，任何理解煉獄語的角色可以翻譯符文如下：

numericDifferences.english: "A wizard named {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} lives in a tower twenty miles from here. I've loaned him a spellbook or two, so he owes me a favor. I can have you delivered safely to his tower, and he can use a {@spell plane shift} spell to take you straight to Elturel. Even more importantly, {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} is looking after an old friend of mine—someone with a history of battling devils in the Nine Hells. I think you'll enjoy her company very much. Her name is {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}."
numericDifferences.localized: "在 20 英里外的一個塔裡住著一個叫做{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}的法師。我借給了他幾本法術書，所以他欠我一個人情。我可以把你們安全的送到他的塔下，然後他可以使用{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}，把你們送去埃爾託瑞爾。更重要的一點是，{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}那裡還有我的一個老朋友——她曾經在九獄和那些魔鬼們戰鬥過。我相信你們會很樂意有她加入你們的隊伍，她的名字叫{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}。"

numericDifferences.english: Characters can help {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} search for his missing tuning fork, which is keyed to the Nine Hells. Whoever rolls the highest on a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds the tuning fork. Whoever rolls the lowest finds a random trinket, determined by rolling on the {@item Trinket|PHB|Trinkets table} in chapter 5 of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} doesn't care if the character keeps the trinket or not, and doesn't remember how or when he acquired it.
numericDifferences.localized: 角色們可以幫助{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}去尋找他不見的音叉，那是他們前往九獄的關鍵。他們所有人進行一次感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，數值最高的角色將發現音叉。數值最低的角色會發現一個隨機的飾品，這個飾品具體是什麼，將在{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}第五章中的{@item Trinket|PHB|飾品表}中投骰決定。{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}不會在乎角色們是否拿走這個飾品，因為他都不記得他是怎麼得到它的了。

numericDifferences.english: In {@adventure chapter 2|BGDIA|2}, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} regains the at-will ability to cast {@spell light} when she arrives in Elturel for the first time.
numericDifferences.localized: 在{@adventure 第二章|BGDIA|2}中，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}會在第 1 次抵達埃爾託瑞爾後獲得隨意施展{@spell light||光亮術}的能力。

numericDifferences.english: Once a holy city whose folk venerated Lathander, Torm, Helm, and Tyr, Elturel is now a site of doom and despair tethered some five hundred feet above the River Styx. Eight great chains bind the city to jagged posts of infernal iron, which stick up out of the ground like gargantuan spikes. (See "{@area Climbing Down|190|x}" at the end of this chapter for a full description of the infernal chains.) The bottoms of those spikes are guarded by scores of devils, making escaping the city by climbing down an arduous task. The Companion, the second sun that provided so much solace and protection to the city for years, now glares down on Elturel like a baleful eye—a black void crackling with lightning.
numericDifferences.localized: 埃爾託瑞爾曾經是一個神聖的城市，人民主要敬拜洛山達，託姆，海姆和提爾，如今已變為一個末日之地，絕望地被束縛在冥河上方約 500 尺處。八條大鐵鏈把這座城市和從地面伸出來的像巨大的尖峰般的鋸齒狀地獄鐵柱樁綁在一起。 （參見本章末尾的"{@area 爬下|190|x}"）這些尖樁的底部被大量魔鬼保護著，使爬下鐵鏈逃離城市的任務變得艱鉅。伴陽，多年來為這座城市提供無數安慰和保護的第二個太陽，現在像一隻滿懷惡意的眼睛——一個爆發閃電的黑色空洞——凝望下方。

numericDifferences.english: Group 1: Abishai and Cultists
numericDifferences.localized: 第一組：亞比莎龍魔和邪教徒

numericDifferences.english: This group is led by the mastermind behind the raid on the cathedral: Victuusa, a {@creature white abishai|MTF}. Victuusa serves both Tiamat and Zariel in an attempt to gain the most favor, and is presently searching for the leaders of the Elturel resistance. It wants nothing more than to deliver the heads of those leaders to Zariel personally. Victuusa leads six lawful evil human {@creature Cultist||cultists} devoted to Zariel.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個小組是由突襲大教堂的策劃人維克託薩，一個{@creature white abishai|MTF|亞比莎白龍魔}親自領導的。維克託薩為提亞馬特和扎瑞爾服務，以爭取最大的嘉獎，他目前正在尋找埃爾託瑞爾抵抗部隊的領導人。它最希望將這些領導人的頭顱親自交給扎瑞爾。維克託薩帶領 6 名忠於扎瑞爾守序邪惡的人類{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}。

numericDifferences.english: Group 2: Crab Attack
numericDifferences.localized: 第二組：蟹群攻擊

numericDifferences.english: Group 3: Devilish Brigands
numericDifferences.localized: 第三組：魔鬼強盜

numericDifferences.english: Group 4: Hellish Hunters
numericDifferences.localized: 第四組：地獄獵人

numericDifferences.english: Three levels make up the High Hall cathedral: the cathedral level (areas H1 through H6), the choir level (areas H7 through H9), and the catacombs level (areas H10 through H17). These locations are keyed to {@adventure map 2.2|BGDIA|2|Map 2.2: High Hall Cathedral}, {@adventure map 2.3|BGDIA|2|Map 2.3: High Hall Cathedral, Choir Level}, and {@adventure map 2.4|BGDIA|2|Map 2.4: High Hall Catacombs}, respectively.
numericDifferences.localized: 至高大廳大教堂由三層組成，分為3區:大教堂區（區域H1至H6 ）,聖詩班區(區域H7至H9)和地下墓穴區（區域H10至H17）。這些位置分別顯示在{@adventure 地圖 2.2|BGDIA|2|Map 2.2: High Hall Cathedral}，{@adventure 地圖 2.3|BGDIA|2|Map 2.3: High Hall Cathedral, Choir Level}和{@adventure 地圖 2.4|BGDIA|2|Map 2.4: High Hall Catacombs}。

numericDifferences.english: Before the characters search for Grand Duke Ravengard in Elturel's cemetery, they should advance to 6th level.
numericDifferences.localized: 在角色前往埃爾託瑞爾的大墓地中搜尋瑞文嘉德大公之前，他們應該升級到六級。

numericDifferences.english: The ten-foot-high brass fence that once surrounded Elturel's cemetery has fallen in numerous places, and a wide gate allowing access to the grounds has been torn from its hinges. Severed humanoid body parts adorn the spikes atop the fence posts. Some of the body parts wriggle and writhe as if undead, twitching in concert with the lightning flashes of the Companion.
numericDifferences.localized: 曾經包圍著埃爾託瑞爾墓地的 10 尺高黃銅圍欄已有很多處倒塌了，通往內部的寬闊大門也從其門鉸處被撕裂。被切斷的類人生物軀體被裝飾在柵欄柱頂上的尖刺上。其中一些殘軀好像不死生物般蠕動抽搐，隨著伴陽的閃電轟雷而顫抖。

numericDifferences.english: Whereas demons attack in disorganized mobs, relying on shock and overwhelming numbers to carry the day, devils organize into a basic unit called a legion. Each legion contains one thousand devils organized as follows:
numericDifferences.localized: 與惡魔們毫無組織地發動攻擊，依靠震懾和壓倒性的數量取勝不同，魔鬼們被組織為一個稱之為軍團的基本單位。每支軍團包含 1000 個魔鬼，組織方式如下：

numericDifferences.english: 5th Infantry Legion, "Infernal Absolution"
numericDifferences.localized: 第五步兵軍團 "地獄赦免"

numericDifferences.english: 13th Cavalry Legion, "{@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s Fury"
numericDifferences.localized: 第十三騎兵軍團 "{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}之怒"

numericDifferences.english: 47th Dreg Legion, "Piteous Fodder"
numericDifferences.localized: 第四十七渣滓軍團"可憐炮灰"

numericDifferences.english: Avernus's combination of oppressive heat and supernatural malevolence weighs on the bodies and souls of those who are not evil. A non-evil creature treats normal travel through Avernus as a forced march and must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each hour of travel. The DC is 10 + 1 for each hour of travel. On a failed saving throw, a creature suffers one level of {@condition exhaustion}.
numericDifferences.localized: 在阿弗納斯，難以忍受的酷熱和超自然的惡意相結合，壓迫著那些非邪惡生物的肉體和靈魂。一個非邪惡陣營生物在穿越阿弗納斯時，如同強行軍一般在每小時旅行結束時需要進行體質豁免。豁免DC為10 + 旅行小時數。一旦豁免失敗，這個生物獲得一個{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級。

numericDifferences.english: Redcaps are murderous fey creatures that soak their caps in fresh blood. Madcaps are redcaps that drench their caps in demon ichor instead. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} currently commands sixty redcaps and thirty madcaps, although a third of them operate outside the fort, patrolling the areas of the wasteland controlled by {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}. As battles deplete this force, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} has new redcaps delivered to her from the Feywild, courtesy of powerful fey with whom she has struck bargains. For this reason, the night hag has no concern for the well-being of her redcap and madcap minions. See {@adventure appendix D|BGDIA|13} for more information about {@creature Redcap|VGM|redcaps} and {@creature Redcap|VGM|madcaps}.
numericDifferences.localized: 紅帽子是嗜殺的精類生物，他們將其帽子浸潤在新鮮血液中。瘋帽子是將自己帽子浸潤在惡魔膿液中而不是血液的紅帽子。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}目前指揮著 60 個紅帽子和 30 個瘋帽子，儘管其中有三分之一在堡壘外{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}控制著的荒原地區巡邏。隨著戰鬥消耗了這支部隊，{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}從妖精荒野那裡獲得了新的一些紅帽子，這是與她進行交易的強大妖精所提供的。由於這個原因，夜鬼婆並不關心她的紅帽子和瘋帽子奴隸們過得好不好。有關{@creature Redcap|VGM|紅帽子}和{@creature Redcap|VGM|紅帽子}的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|BGDIA|13}。

numericDifferences.english: The hag instructs {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and the characters to take up places within the circle. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} tells the characters to close their eyes and keep them closed, that the ritual should last about ten minutes, and that during the ritual all within the circle will be joined by a telepathic bond. If anyone leaves the circle, the ritual is interrupted and she'll be forced to start over. An incomplete ritual yields no insight into {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memories.
numericDifferences.localized: 鬼婆指示{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和角色們在法陣中佔據一些位置。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}告訴角色們閉上眼睛並且保持雙眼緊閉，該儀式應持續約 10 分鐘，並且在儀式期間，法陣中的所有人都會被一個心靈感應連結聯絡起來。如果有人離開法陣，儀式將被打斷，她將被迫重新開始。不完整的儀式無法使人們知曉{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的記憶。

numericDifferences.english: The characters must defend {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and Zariel from the six {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils}. At this point, the characters and the devils should roll initiative. The dreamscape combat that follows pits the characters against the dream-devils. The characters begin combat at full hit points, minus any psychic damage taken in the previous dream. All damage dealt by the dream-devils converts to psychic damage. The devils let out dying screams and fall dead when reduced to 0 hit points.
numericDifferences.localized: 角色們必須保護{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和扎瑞爾免受 6 只{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}的傷害。此時，角色們和魔鬼應該進行先攻檢定。隨後的夢境戰鬥使角色與夢境魔鬼交戰。角色開始戰鬥時會獲得的生命值為滿值生命值減去在先前夢中所受到的心靈傷害。夢境魔鬼所造成的所有傷害都轉化為心靈傷害。當它們的HP被降到 0 時，魔鬼會發出垂死的尖叫聲然後死亡。

numericDifferences.english: {@creature Feonor|BGDIA} rides around in a {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA} called {@i Golden Doom}, so named because Mahadi fitted it with gilded death armor (see "{@vehupgrade Gilded Death Armor|BGDIA}"). The vehicle is driven by a {@creature ghast}, and its other stations are operated by {@creature Ghoul||ghouls}. She also commands a force of ten {@creature Crawling Claw||crawling claws}. A pair of {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|Tormentors} crewed by {@creature Mezzoloth||mezzoloths} provide escort.
numericDifferences.localized: {@creature Feonor|BGDIA|菲奧諾}坐在一臺名為{@i 黃金厄運}的{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}上，之所以這樣命名是因為馬哈迪給這臺戰車安裝了鍍金死亡裝甲（請參閱"{@vehupgrade Gilded Death Armor|BGDIA|鍍金死亡裝甲}"）。這臺戰車由一隻{@creature ghast||妖鬼}駕駛，其餘部分由{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}操作。她同時也指揮著一支由 10 只{@creature Crawling Claw||蠕行之爪}組成的戰力。兩臺由{@creature Mezzoloth||毒蟲羅斯魔}作為車組的{@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}為她提供護衛。

numericDifferences.english: Kovik has a {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA} and travels with two {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} on similar vehicles. The rest of the gang consists of four {@creature Barbed Devil||barbed devils} on a {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA} and eight {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} on a {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA}. Members of the Eighth Remnant never use demon ichor in their vehicles.
numericDifferences.localized: 科維克有著一臺{@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}，兩隻{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}騎在類似的戰車上和他一起行進。這個幫派剩下的成員包含了在一臺{@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}上的 4 只{@creature Barbed Devil||蝟魔}和在一臺{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}上的 8 只{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}。第八殘餘的成員從來都不在他們的戰車上使用惡魔穢液。

numericDifferences.english: If the characters free Jander or any of his companions, their bodies crumble to dust in grateful release. In response, twenty {@creature Stirge||stirges} attack the group. When the second round of combat begins, any crucified souls remaining on the trees wail in terror as Haruman, a {@creature narzugon|MTF}, swoops down from the sky on his {@creature nightmare} steed to punish the interlopers. He begins the encounter 300 feet away and orders the nightmare to close the distance between him and the adventurers as quickly as possible. As Haruman attacks, a {@creature hellwasp|BGDIA} appears from a nearby nest and tries to grab {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and fly off with her (see "Development" below).
numericDifferences.localized: 如果這些角色釋放了詹德或他的任何同伴，他們的身體就會在感激不盡的解脫中化為塵土。作為回應，20 只{@creature Stirge||蚊蝠}會攻擊他們這個團隊。在戰鬥的第二輪開始時，當哈魯曼——一名{@creature narzugon|MTF|魘騎魔}駕駛著{@creature nightmare||夢魘}坐騎從空中猛衝出來懲罰入侵者時，任何仍被釘在樹上的靈魂都會在恐懼中哀號。他會在 300 尺外開始這場遭遇，並命令夢魘儘快拉近他和冒險者們之間的距離。當哈魯曼攻擊時，一隻{@creature hellwasp|BGDIA|黃泉蜂}會從附近的巢穴中出現，試圖抓住{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}並帶著她飛走(請參閱下方的"發展")。

numericDifferences.english: A typical hellwasp nest contains eight {@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|hellwasps}, although twice this number are typically out hunting when the characters arrive. If they paralyze every character in the party with their stings, the hellwasps move them to their larder at the top of the nest ({@area area N4|1f7|x}) to be used as food for their larvae.
numericDifferences.localized: 一個典型的黃泉蜂巢穴中會有著 8 只{@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|黃泉蜂}，但是當角色們到達巢穴時通常會有兩倍於此數量的黃泉蜂出來狩獵他們。如果它們用它們的釘刺麻痺了隊伍中的每個角色，黃泉蜂就會把他們帶到巢穴頂部的儲藏室({@area 區域N4|1f7|x})，來作為它們幼蟲的食物。

numericDifferences.english: Anyone searching through the junk finds a backpack containing five {@item Healer's Kit|PHB|healer's kits} and a fully charged {@item wand of magic missiles}.
numericDifferences.localized: 任何翻找這堆垃圾的人都能夠找到一個放著 5 個{@item Healer's Kit|PHB|醫療包}和一個滿充能的{@item wand of magic missiles||魔法飛彈魔杖}的揹包。

numericDifferences.english: Too much noise here alerts the hellwasps in area N2. Creatures rooting through the junk must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check or alert the wasps. Once the colony is placed on alert, call for initiative rolls. All the hellwasps act on the same initiative count. At the start of each of the hellwasps' turns, one {@creature hellwasp|BGDIA} arrives from area N2 to defend the nest until all three appear. The rest of the colony remains on high alert for two hours.
numericDifferences.localized: 在這發出太多的噪音會警示區域N2的黃泉蜂。翻找垃圾堆的生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 12}的敏捷({@skill Stealth||隱匿})檢定，否則會驚動黃泉蜂。一旦該群落處於警戒狀態，要求進行先攻檢定。所有的黃泉蜂都使用同一個先攻骰值。在黃泉蜂每回合開始時，會有一隻{@creature hellwasp|BGDIA|黃泉蜂}從區域N2過來保衛巢穴，直到共 3 只黃泉蜂全部出現。群落的其他成員也會保持高度警惕兩個小時。

numericDifferences.english: The hellwasps gum their victims to the walls of this level using the same regurgitated bile that forms their nest. Two {@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|hellwasps} are stationed here at all hours.
numericDifferences.localized: 黃泉蜂用形成巢穴的反芻膽液將受害者們黏在這層的牆上。2 只{@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|黃泉蜂}會一直駐紮在這裡。

numericDifferences.english: Ruined gear belonging to previous abductees is scattered across the floor. Characters who search through the gear find three {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} and a {@item helm of telepathy}.
numericDifferences.localized: 那些屬於之前的被綁者的廢棄裝備散落在地板上。翻找這些裝備的角色們能夠發現 3 枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}和一個{@item helm of telepathy||心靈感應頭盔}。

numericDifferences.english: Zariel dispatched infernal cleanup crews to scour the lake shores for the trees and destroy them before they become thickets. When the characters arrive, they encounter a work crew of five {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} in the process of raising a pyre around a tree to incinerate it. Four of the devils tease the fifth, whose name is Krikendolt. A vrock savaged Krikendolt's skull during one of the many battles of the Blood War, leaving him with terrible scars and a brain injury that has turned his alignment to chaotic good. Krikendolt's comrades learned that he pities the abyssal chickens, and they are now goading him into slaughtering the chickens on pain of death. Secretly, Krikendolt keeps an {@creature abyssal chicken|BGDIA} named Earwax in his sack.
numericDifferences.localized: 扎瑞爾派出了地獄的清理人員在湖岸上搜尋這些樹木並在它們長成叢林之前摧毀掉它們。當角色們到達時，他們遇到了一個由 5 名{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}組成的工作小組，他們正在一棵樹周圍堆起柴堆，準備把它燒成灰燼。其中四個魔鬼正在戲弄第五個魔鬼，他的名字是克里肯多特。在血戰的一場戰鬥中，一名鷲魔猛擊了克里肯多特的頭部，這給他留下了可怕的傷疤以及大腦損傷，然而這使他的陣營轉變為了混亂善良。克里肯多特的同事們得知了他在同情深淵雞，於是他們現在正命令並驅趕他去屠殺這些雞，違令則處死他。然而克里肯多特在他的口袋裡秘密地養了一隻叫做耳垢的{@creature abyssal chicken|BGDIA|深淵雞}。

numericDifferences.english: The devils don't know where the Bleeding Citadel is, but they do know someone who could help. For the price of a {@item soul coin|BGDIA}, the devils direct the group to a mysterious outlander (see "Development" below). If the characters are unable to pay, they must return later with the coin and track down the fiends on the lake shore.
