numericDifferences.localized: 魔鬼們不知道湧血城砦在哪裡，但是他們知道有某些人可以幫上忙。只要支付 1 枚{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}的價格，這些魔鬼們就會帶著角色們去見一個神秘的外鄉人（請參閱下文的"發展"條目）。如果角色們無法支付，那他們必須稍後帶著靈魂幣回來湖岸邊找到這些邪魔。

numericDifferences.english: The fiends carry five {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} and three vials of {@area demon ichor|1a7|x}.
numericDifferences.localized: 這些邪魔擁有 5 枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}以及 3 瓶{@area 惡魔穢液|1a7|x}。

numericDifferences.english: Mordenkainen takes the tower with him when he leaves Avernus. Its empty iron foundations remain behind to mark the site, and when the tower returns, it locks itself into place with a satisfying clunk. Mordenkainen pays yugoloths to carry out his bidding in Avernus. His wages are so attractive that these fiends have taken to gathering outside his tower. There are nine {@creature Mezzoloth||mezzoloths} and three {@creature Nycaloth||nycaloths} present here at any time. The fiends aren't looking for trouble, since they're more interested in landing a lucrative contract with the mage.
numericDifferences.localized: 魔鄧肯在他離開阿弗納斯時會帶著他的法師塔一起。只有空蕩蕩的鐵質地基留在原處標記出位置，然後當法師塔返回時，塔會隨著一聲令人滿足的沉悶金屬聲把它自己固定在那裡。魔鄧肯會付錢給尤格羅斯魔讓他們在阿弗納斯執行他的命令。他的出價是如此地誘人以至於這些邪魔都聚集在他的塔外面。這裡隨時都會有著 9 只{@creature Mezzoloth||毒蟲羅斯魔}和 3 只{@creature Nycaloth||征伐羅斯魔}。這些邪魔不是來找麻煩的，他們對於和法師簽訂一份豐厚的合同更感興趣。

numericDifferences.english: Two of the nycaloths—Torgrazk and Shraal—are loyal to Zariel and have been sent here to assassinate Mordenkainen. If they overhear his discussions with the characters, the assassins decide to alter their plans. Both fiends turn {@condition invisible} and follow the party in hope of an opportunity to kidnap one or more characters and deliver them to Zariel. If they succeed, Zariel invites the rest of the group to her flying fortress to negotiate terms for their comrades' release (see "{@area Zariel's Flying Fortress|2b0|x}").
numericDifferences.localized: 其中兩個征伐羅斯魔，托拉格拉茲克和什拉爾，是效忠於扎瑞爾的，並且他們被派來暗殺魔鄧肯。如果他們偷聽到了魔鄧肯和角色們的討論，這些暗殺者們會決定改變他們的計劃。兩隻邪魔都會在變得{@condition invisible||隱形}後尾隨團隊以希望有機會抓住 1 個或者更多的角色們交於扎瑞爾。如果他們成功了，扎瑞爾會邀請團隊剩下的角色到她的飛行堡壘來協商關於釋放他們同伴的條款（請參閱"{@area 扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘|2b0|x}"）。

numericDifferences.english: You gain the benefits of a {@spell true seeing} spell for the next hour.
numericDifferences.localized: 你在接下來的 1 小時裡獲得{@spell true seeing||真知術}的效果。

numericDifferences.english: The standing stone casts {@spell magic missile}, targeting you with five missiles.
numericDifferences.localized: 這塊立石對你釋放有 5 發飛彈的{@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈}。

numericDifferences.english: An illusory swarm of harmless bats or pigeons (DM's choice) flutters over your head for the next hour. A {@spell dispel magic} cast on the swarm ends the effect.
numericDifferences.localized: 接下來 1 小時裡一群無害的蝙蝠或者鴿子幻影在你的頭頂盤旋。{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}可以結束這個效應。

numericDifferences.english: A shatterstick is a nonmagical, 12-inch-long, 4-pound stake made of blue-tinged infernal iron mined on Cania, the eighth layer of the Nine Hells. When embedded in earth or pounded into solid rock, the stake emits a seismic vibration in a 20-foot radius centered on itself for 1 minute, shaking the ground in that area for the duration. When the effects ends, the shatterstick breaks apart, becoming useless, and all structures within 20 feet of it take 35 ({@dice 10d6}) bludgeoning damage.
numericDifferences.localized: 粉碎棒是一種非魔法的 12 寸長 4 磅重的棍子，由開採於九獄的第八層卡尼亞的泛藍煉獄鋼製成。當棍子嵌入泥土或被插進堅硬的岩石中時，它會在半徑 20 尺內以自身為中心發出一種持續一分鐘的地震振動，震動該範圍內的地面。當效應結束時，粉碎棒會碎裂並失去作用，它周圍 20 尺內的所有建築物都會受到 35（{@dice 10d6}）點鈍擊傷害。

numericDifferences.english: Long ago, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} imprisoned a rival pit fiend named Shummrath at the bottom of this deep chasm. Over the years, Shummrath has been reduced to a fetid lake of slime. Ancient regenerative properties maintain some semblance of life within the sludge, allowing visitors to communicate with Shummrath telepathically. However, a tributary stream from the River Styx has spilled into his canyon and polluted the devil's mind. Shummrath now only retains thirty seconds of memory and conveys a single thought repeatedly.
numericDifferences.localized: 很久以前。{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}把一個競爭對手，名叫舒姆拉斯的深獄煉魔，囚禁在這個深峽的底部。多年後，舒姆拉斯已經淪為一個惡臭的黏液湖。古老的再生特性在這些爛泥中維持了一些生命的表象，允許訪客與舒姆拉斯進行心靈感應溝通。然而，一條來自冥河的支流流入了他的峽谷，汙染了魔鬼的思想。舒姆拉斯現在只能保留 30 秒的記憶，並重復地表達一個念頭。

numericDifferences.english: Two ornate, black arches dominate the scorched landscape for miles, each one rising two hundred feet into the stiflingly hot air. Every inch of stonework is engraved with images of devils waging war against demons.
numericDifferences.localized: 兩座華麗的黑色的拱門主宰著數英里內焦土的景色，每一道都高達 200 尺，直衝悶熱雲霄。拱門到處都雕刻著魔鬼對抗惡魔的戰爭影象。

numericDifferences.english: The barge is 30 feet long, 15 feet wide, and sturdy enough to transport up to two Huge infernal war machines. Twelve {@creature Merregon|MTF|merregons} under the command of a {@creature bone devil} named Krinjak operate the barge's oars. Krinjak's instructions are to take the characters where they need to go. Although it professes loyalty to {@creature Bel|BGDIA}, Krinjak is secretly a spy for Zariel. After taking the characters as close to the sibriex as the River Styx allows, it flies off to warn Zariel that the characters are working for {@creature Bel|BGDIA}.
numericDifferences.localized: 駁船長 30 尺，寬 15 尺，堅實可靠，足以運載兩個巨型地獄戰車。12 個{@creature Merregon|MTF|軍團魔}在一個名叫克林賈克的{@creature bone devil||骨魔}的號令下操槳。克林賈克得到的命令是帶著角色們去他們需要去的地方。雖然它自稱向{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}效忠，克林賈克其實暗地裡是扎瑞爾的間諜。在把角色們載到冥河上最接近巨顱魔的地方放下後，它會飛走去向彙報扎瑞爾：角色們在為{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}效命。

numericDifferences.english: Spiky chains lash a fifteen-foot-diameter, floating blob of quivering flesh to a 20-foot-tall wrought-iron scaffold. Two fiends wrapped in chains stand atop the scaffold, torturing the bloated creature's flesh by tightening its chains. Demon ichor oozes from its wounds, forming a shallow pool around the scaffolding.
numericDifferences.localized: 帶著尖刺的鐵鏈將一坨直徑為 15 尺的聳動肉球捆在了離地二十米處的鑄鐵刑臺上。兩個渾身被鐵鏈包裹著的邪魔執掌著刑臺上的鐵鏈，他們拉緊鏈條，折磨這個被束縛著的腫脹肉球。惡魔穢液這個惡魔的傷口中流出， 在刑臺下形成了一個淺淺的池子。

numericDifferences.english: Fetchtatter wears a {@item ring of x-ray vision} on its right hand. In the pockets of its bile-stained robe are two {@item Potion of Greater Healing||potions of greater healing} and six {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}. The arcanaloth also carries a grimy spellbook bound in chasme flesh. Fetchtatter's spellbook contains all the spells the arcanaloth has prepared.
numericDifferences.localized: 斐熾泰格的右手戴有一枚{@item ring of x-ray vision||X射線戒指}。它沾染著膽汁的袍子口袋裡藏有兩瓶{@item Potion of Greater Healing||高等治療藥水}以及 6 枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。這個奧法羅斯魔還帶著一本汙穢的用喀嘶魔的血肉製成的法術書。斐熾泰格的法術書記載了所有這隻奧法羅斯魔能準備的法術。

numericDifferences.english: A towering wreck rises from the scorched hellscape. It looks like a giant sword blade, tilted to a twenty-degree angle and partly buried underground. Much of its exposed hull is rusted and torn asunder. Hot wind screams as it tears through the hollow structure, and six giant vultures circle high above it.
numericDifferences.localized: 一個塔狀的廢墟在灼熱的地獄中拔地而起。它的外觀看起來像是一把巨劍的劍刃，略有 20 度左右的傾斜，且部分被埋入了地下。它裸露在外的部分已經變得生鏽開裂，破爛不堪。熾熱的狂風從這片廢墟呼嘯而過，六隻巨大的禿鷲在上空高高地盤旋著。

numericDifferences.english: After demons crippled this fortress in battle, Zariel abandoned it and left it to rust. The fortress is 150 feet tall, but the lower third of it is buried underground. All the lower decks have been picked clean, but the command deck at the top still holds promise. Characters can scale the wreck's torn outer hull to reach this deck, which is 80 feet off the ground at its lowest point. Climbing the outside of the wreck without proper gear requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Characters who can fly have no trouble reaching the command deck.
numericDifferences.localized: 自從惡魔們在戰鬥中將這個堡壘擊墜後，扎瑞爾就拋棄了它，任由它在此地生鏽。這個堡壘有 150 尺高，但是底下的 1/3 已經被埋入了地下。所有的底層甲板都被一掃而空，但是指揮層可能還未被搜刮。角色們可以透過攀爬廢墟撕裂的外壁來到達指揮所在層，這裡的最低點離地也有 80 尺。如果沒有合適的裝備輔助，攀爬廢墟外壁需要透過一個{@dc 15}的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。可以飛行的角色能毫無阻礙地抵達指揮層。

numericDifferences.english: Bone whelks are large mollusks that excrete an adhesive to attach skulls, bones, and other detritus to their bodies for protection. These slugs scour the wreck for organic matter to feed on, clinging to torn sections of wall, floor, and ceiling while taking shelter from the searing winds and hungry vrocks. Characters who try to make their way up through the interior of the wreck are attacked by five {@creature Bone Whelk|BGDIA|bone whelks}. Too slow to mount an effective escape, the bone whelks fight to the death.
numericDifferences.localized: 骸骨螺是一種大型無脊椎動物，會分泌一種黏液將顱骨，遺骸和其他腐殖粘附在自己身上形成一層保護殼。這些蛞蝓搜刮著廢墟中的各類有機物質來填飽肚子，緊緊地貼著天花板，牆壁和地板的斷壁殘垣行走，躲避著咆哮的狂風和飢渴的鷲魔們。試圖從內部爬上指揮層的角色們會遭到 5 只{@creature Bone Whelk|BGDIA|骸骨螺}的攻擊。這些傢伙想爬著逃走實在是太慢了，所以他們將會戰鬥至死。

numericDifferences.english: {@b Slant}. Like the rest of the fortress, the command deck leans at a twenty-degree angle, with {@area area W5|27a|x} being the lowest part of the deck and {@area area W8|281|x} being the highest. The sloped metal floor is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
numericDifferences.localized: {@b 傾斜}。和堡壘的其他部分一樣，指揮層也傾斜 20 度。{@area 區域W5|27a|x}是它的最低點，而{@area 區域W8|281|x}是最高點。傾斜的地板被視為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

numericDifferences.english: Each machine resembles a metal file cabinet covered with switches and dials that no longer do anything. A character who spends at least 1 hour taking apart a machine can discern its original purpose with a successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check:
numericDifferences.localized: 這兩臺機器都像是金屬檔案櫃一般，其上遍佈著已經失去作用的開關和錶盤。一位花費至少一小時來研究分析這對機器的角色可以透過一個{@dc 20}的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定得知：

numericDifferences.english: This dark room contains a metal console that has torn free of the wall to your right. Pinned between the console and another wall is a small, desiccated, winged devil that looks like it was crushed to death. In another corner stands a 3-foot block of infernal iron—a locked safe with clawed feet and a three-dial mechanism built into its thick door. Each dial bears numerals written in Infernal.
numericDifferences.localized: 這間漆黑的房間裡有一個從你們右手邊的牆上撕下來的金屬控制檯。在控制檯和另一面牆之間有一隻小號的乾透了的有翼魔鬼，看起來似乎是被砸死的。在另一個角落以一塊三尺見方的煉獄鐵箱——這是一個有著爪形腳，厚重的門上帶著三個機械錶盤的保險櫃。每個錶盤上都用煉獄語寫著數字。

numericDifferences.english: This room contains two rusty iron crates in one corner and an iron, bell-shaped contraption bolted to the floor in the opposite corner. The bell is nine feet tall and painted black, with several dents and dings in it. Every so often, the bell emits a loud "ka-clunk" sound.
numericDifferences.localized: 這間房間裡的一角有著兩個鏽跡斑斑的鐵板條箱，在相對的另一角有著一個鐵製的喇叭狀的精巧裝置被螺栓固定在了地上。這個被塗黑的裝置有 9 尺高，有幾個凹凸不平的痕跡。不時地，這個喇叭就發出響亮的"咔嚓"聲響。

numericDifferences.english: This chamber contains a stripped-down metal console and several rusty pipes that extend from floor to ceiling. One of the pipes has a two-foot-long gash in it.
numericDifferences.localized: 這間房間內有著一個被拆卸的金屬製控制檯，還有一些鏽跡斑斑的管道聯通著地板和天花板。其中一根管道有著一個 2 尺長的劃口。

numericDifferences.english: Twelve {@creature Barbed Devil||barbed devils} patrol the dock in groups of three devils each. If Zariel's flying fortress is present, three {@creature Bone Devil||bone devils} also circle overhead. Intruders are attacked or warned away. If the characters try to negotiate with the devils, Bazelsteen swoops down to deal with them personally.
numericDifferences.localized: 12 個{@creature Barbed Devil||蝟魔}在甲板上三個一組進行巡邏。如果扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘在港，另有 3 個{@creature Bone Devil||骨魔}在天上盤旋。任何闖入者都會被打走，或是警告驅離。如果角色們希望和魔鬼做個交易，巴澤勒斯滕會親自落地和他們私下裡談。

numericDifferences.english: The salamanders can repair a damaged but functional infernal war machine at a cost of 50 gp per hit point restored.
numericDifferences.localized: 火蜥蜴可以修復受損但功能正常的地獄戰爭機器，每恢復1點生命值的費用是50金幣。

numericDifferences.english: If {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} is freed, Trantolox and the rest of the demons in {@area area S14|2e4|x} investigate. The nalfeshnee attempts to control {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA}, but Yeenoghu's pet answers only to the Gnoll Lord. After Trantolox tries to control {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} for 3 rounds, the nalfeshnee and the other demons retreat back to {@area area S14|2e4|x}.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}被釋放，Trantolox和{@area 區域S14|2e4|x}中的其餘惡魔將會進行調查。判魂魔試圖控制{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}，但耶諾古的寵物只聽從鬣狗人領主的命令。在Trantolox嘗試控制{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}三輪之後，判魂魔和其他惡魔撤退回{@area 區域S14|2e4|x}。

numericDifferences.english: 1 {@creature archmage} accompanied by a {@creature shield guardian}
numericDifferences.localized: 1名{@creature archmage||大法師}伴隨著1名{@creature shield guardian||構裝盾衛}

numericDifferences.english: {@b Flip}. The vehicle flips over, falls {@condition prone}, and comes to a dead stop in an unoccupied space. Any unsecured creature holding on to the outside of the vehicle must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be thrown off, landing {@condition prone} in a random unoccupied space within 20 feet of the overturned vehicle. Creatures inside the vehicle fall {@condition prone} and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) bludgeoning damage.
numericDifferences.localized: {@b 翻車}。車子翻了，陷入{@condition prone||伏地}狀態，並且會熄火停在一處未佔據空間。所有爬在車外且沒有安全措施的生物必須透過一個{@dc 20}的力量豁免來防止被甩出去，失敗的生物會被隨機扔到車輛的 20 尺內一處未佔據空間，並處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態。車內的生物會處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態，並且需要透過 1 次{@dc 15}的力量檢定，否則受到 10（{@dice 3d6}）點鈍擊傷害。

numericDifferences.english: When an infernal war machine is damaged, suffers a mishap, or gains one or more levels of {@condition exhaustion}, a creature can attempt to make repairs to the vehicle. The creature making the repairs must meet the following criteria:
numericDifferences.localized: 當地獄戰爭機器受損，遭到厄運，或是得到 1 級或更高的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}時，人物可以嘗試維修戰車。進行維修的生物必須滿足下列條件：

numericDifferences.english: Before beginning repairs, a creature must decide whether the repairs are aimed at ending a mishap, removing a level of {@condition exhaustion}, or restoring the damaged vehicle's hit points. Each option is discussed below.
numericDifferences.localized: 在開始維修前，生物必須決定維修的目的是結束厄運，解除 1 級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，或是恢復戰車的HP。三種選項的詳述見下文。
